            function Character.Util.safeIndex(p3, ...)
                for _, v in ipairs({ ... }) do
                    if type(p3) == "table" then
                        v44 = false
                    else
                        v44 = typeof(p3) ~= "Instance"
                    end

                    if v44 then
                        return nil
                    end

                    local ok, result = pcall(function()
                        return p3[v]
                    end)
                    local v43

                    if not ok or result == nil then
                        if typeof(p3) ~= "Instance" then
                            return nil
                        end

                        local ok2

                        ok2, ok = pcall(function()
                            return p3:FindFirstChild(ok2)
                        end)

                        if not (ok2 and ok) then
                            return nil
                        end

                        v43 = ok
                        p3 = v43
                    else
                        v43 = result
                        p3 = v43
                    end
                end

                return p3
            end
            function Character.Util.flagValue(p4)
                local UI = Character.UI

                if UI then
                    UI = Character.UI.Window
                end

                local Flags = UI and UI.Flags

                if not Flags then
                    if Flags then
                        UI = Flags.Value

                        if type(UI) == "nil" then
                            UI = Flags.Get

                            if type(UI) ~= "function" then
                                return nil
                            end

                            return
                        else
                            return Flags.Value
                        end

                        return
                    else
                        return nil
                    end

                    return
                end

                Flags = UI.Flags[p4]

                if Flags then
                    UI = Flags.Value

                    if type(UI) == "nil" then
                        UI = Flags.Get

                        if type(UI) ~= "function" then
                            return nil
                        end

                        return
                    else
                        return Flags.Value
                    end

                    return
                else
                    return nil
                end
            end

                        local v51 = type(k) == "number" and v and v or k

                        if type(v51) ~= "string" then
                        end

                        if v then
                            t3[#t3 + 1] = v51

                    end

                    return t3
                end

                local v52

                if type(v47) == "string" then
                    v52 = v47 ~= ""
                else
                    v52 = false
                end

                if not v52 then
                    return t3
                end

                t3[1] = v47

                return t3
            end

            function Character.Util.CopyToClipboard(p14)
                local v58
                local function v59()
                    if setclipboard then
                        setclipboard(v58)

                        return
                    end

                    if toclipboard then
                        toclipboard(v58)

                        return
                    end

                    local Clipboard_ = Clipboard

                    if not Clipboard_ then
                        if Clipboard_ then
                            Clipboard.set(v58)

                            return
                        else
                            error("No clipboard function found")

                            return
                        end

                        return
                    end

                    Clipboard_ = Clipboard.set

                    if Clipboard_ then
                        Clipboard.set(v58)

                        return
                    else
                        error("No clipboard function found")

                        return
                    end
                end
                v58 = p14

                return pcall(v59)
            end

            isfolder_ = function(p25)
                if p25 == "nil" and true or p25 == nil then
                    return nil, nil
                else
                    local chunk, v76 = loadstring("return " .. p25)

                    if chunk then
                        chunk = { pcall(chunk) }
                        v76 = chunk[2]

                        if chunk[1] then
                            return v76, nil
                        else
                            return nil, tostring(v76)
                        end

                        return
                    else
                        return nil, "loadstring: " .. tostring(v76)
                    end

                    return
                end
            end
            makefolder_ = function(p26, p27, p28, p29)
                local chunk, result = loadstring("local a, b, c, out = ...; local res = a; " .. p26 .. "; return out")

                if chunk then
                    chunk, result = pcall(chunk, p27, p28, p29, nil)

                    if chunk then
                        return result, nil
                    else
                        return nil, tostring(result)
                    end

                    return
                else
                    return nil, "loadstring: " .. tostring(result)
                end
            end

            Character.RewardHook = {}
            Character.RewardHook.QUEUE = "__MH_REWARD_Q"
            Character.RewardHook._installed = false
            Character.RewardHook.SRC = [[    local QUEUE_NAME = ...
    if _G.__MH_REWARD_HOOK then return end          -- never double-hook one VM (corrupts chain)
    _G.__MH_REWARD_HOOK = true

    local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local remotes = RS:FindFirstChild("Assets") and RS.Assets:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
    local GET = remotes and remotes:FindFirstChild("GET")
    if not GET then return end
    if not (getrawmetatable and setreadonly and newcclosure and getnamecallmethod) then return end

    local HS = game:GetService("HttpService")
    local function q()
        local v = workspace:FindFirstChild(QUEUE_NAME)
        if not v then v = Instance.new("StringValue"); v.Name = QUEUE_NAME; v.Value = ""; v.Parent = workspace end
        return v
    end

    -- Build a SMALL table from the return value. Two shapes:
    --  * "Get"   -> a = { Obtained = {currency=n, Perks={}, Drops={}}, Stats = {...} }
    --  * "Chest" -> a = ARRAY of item objects { {Rarity=, Tag/Real_Tag=name}, ... }
    -- Only small scalar/string fields are read; the big player-data table is never touched.
    local function extract(kind, a)
        if type(a) ~= "table" then return nil end
        local o = { obtained = {}, perks = {}, drops = {}, stats = {} }
        if kind == "Chest" then
            -- chest contents: list of item objects with a display name + rarity
            for _, item in ipairs(a) do
                if type(item) == "table" then
                    local nm = item.Real_Tag or item.Tag or item.Name
                    if nm ~= nil then o.drops[#o.drops+1] = tostring(nm) end
                end
            end
            return o
        end
        -- "Get": run-info table
        local ob = a.Obtained
        if type(ob) == "table" then
            for k, v in pairs(ob) do
                if type(v) == "number" then o.obtained[tostring(k)] = v
                elseif k == "Perks" and type(v) == "table" then
                    for _, pn in pairs(v) do o.perks[#o.perks+1] = tostring(pn) end
                elseif k == "Drops" and type(v) == "table" then
                    for _, dn in pairs(v) do o.drops[#o.drops+1] = tostring(dn) end
                end
            end
        end
        local st = a.Stats
        if type(st) == "table" then
            for _, key in ipairs({ "Time_Taken", "Damage", "Kills", "Crits", "Waves" }) do
                local n = st[key]
                if type(n) == "number" then o.stats[key] = n end
            end
        end
        if a.Completed ~= nil then o.completed = a.Completed and true or false end
        return o
    end

    local function push(kind, a)
        local ok, small = pcall(extract, kind, a)
        if not ok or not small then return end
        small.kind = kind
        local ok2, json = pcall(function() return HS:JSONEncode(small) end)
        if not ok2 then return end
        local v = q()
        local cur = v.Value
        if #cur > 100000 then cur = "" end
        v.Value = cur .. json .. "\n"
    end

    local mt = getrawmetatable(game)
    local old = mt.__namecall
    setreadonly(mt, false)
    mt.__namecall = newcclosure(function(self, ...)
        if self == GET then
            local ok, m = pcall(getnamecallmethod)
            if ok and m == "InvokeServer" then
                local a2 = select(2, ...)
                if (...) == "S_Rewards" and (a2 == "Get" or a2 == "Chest") then
                    -- Run the real call EXACTLY ONCE. Capture both returns so we can pass
                    -- them through untouched, but only ever READ `a` (small run-info).
                    -- `b` (full player data) is forwarded verbatim and never inspected.
                    local a, b = old(self, ...)
                    pcall(push, a2, a)
                    return a, b
                end
            end
        end
        return old(self, ...)
    end)
    setreadonly(mt, true)
]]
            Character.RewardHook._get = nil
            Character.RewardHook._chest = nil
            Character.RewardHook._stamp = 0

            function Character.RewardHook.drain()
                local v93 = workspace:FindFirstChild(Character.RewardHook.QUEUE)

                if not v93 or v93.Value == "" then
                    return
                end
            end
            function Character.RewardHook.reset()
                Character.RewardHook._get = nil
                Character.RewardHook._chest = nil

                local v94 = workspace:FindFirstChild(Character.RewardHook.QUEUE)

                if not v94 then
                    return
                end

                v94.Value = ""
            end
            function Character.RewardHook.start()
                if Character.RewardHook._installed then
                    return
                else
                    local run_on_actor_ = run_on_actor

                    run_on_actor_ = type(run_on_actor_) == "function" and run_on_actor or nil

                    local getactors_ = getactors

                    if type(getactors_) == "function" then
                        getactors_ = getactors
                    else
                        getactors_ = false
                    end

                    getactors_ = getactors_ or nil

                    if not (run_on_actor_ and getactors_) then
                        t1.value7("RewardHook: executor lacks run_on_actor/getactors \226\128\148 reward hook disabled")

                        return
                    end

                    return
                end
            end

                    end
                    value4 = result
                end

                return Character.UI.clickGui(value4)
            end

				["Lobby"] = 14916516914,

			}
            Character.LOBBY_PLACE_IDS = {}
            queue_on_teleport_ = function(p45)
                Character.Lobby.busyLobby[p45] = true
            end

            for _, v in pairs(Character.PLACE) do
                Character.LOBBY_PLACE_IDS[v] = true
            end

            function Character.isInGame()
                if Character.LOBBY_PLACE_IDS[game.PlaceId] then
                    return false
                else
                    return workspace:FindFirstChild("Titans") ~= nil
                end
            end

            isfolder_ = Character.isInGame
            Character.Char = {}

            function Character.Char.get()
                local Character2 = t1.value3.Character

                if Character2 then
                    local HumanoidRootPart = Character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    local v108 = not HumanoidRootPart
                    local Humanoid = Character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                    if v108 or (not Humanoid or Humanoid.Health <= 0) then
                        return nil
                    else
                        return Character2, HumanoidRootPart, Humanoid
                    end

                    return
                else
                    return nil
                end
            end
            function Character.Char.setAnchor(p46)
                local value = select(2, Character.Char.get())

                if not value then
                    return
                end

                pcall(function()
                    value.Anchored = p46
                end)
            end
            function Character.Char.getRig()
                local Character2 = t1.value3.Character

                if Character2 then
                    for _, child in ipairs(Character2:GetChildren()) do
                        if child.Name:match("^Rig_") then
                            return child
                        end
                    end
                end

                Character2 = workspace:FindFirstChild("Characters")

                if Character2 then
                    Character2 = Character2:FindFirstChild(t1.value3.Name)
                end

                if not Character2 then
                    return nil
                end

                for _, child in ipairs(Character2:GetChildren()) do
                    if child.Name:match("^Rig_") then
                        return child
                    end
                end

                return nil
            end
            function Character.Char.getBlade1()
                return Character.Util.safeIndex(Character.Char.getRig(), "LeftHand", "Blade_1")
            end
            function Character.Char.allSetsUsed()
                local LowerTorso = Character.Char.getRig()
                local v117

                if not LowerTorso then
                    if LowerTorso then
                        for i = 1, 3 do
                            v117 = LowerTorso:FindFirstChild("Left_" .. i, true)

                            if v117 then
                                v117 = v117:GetAttribute("Used") == nil
                            end

                            if v117 then
                                return false
                            end
                        end

                        return true
                    else
                        return false
                    end

                    return
                end

                LowerTorso = LowerTorso:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso")

                if LowerTorso then
                    for i = 1, 3 do
                        v117 = LowerTorso:FindFirstChild("Left_" .. i, true)

                        if v117 then
                            v117 = v117:GetAttribute("Used") == nil
                        end

                        if v117 then
                            return false
                        end
                    end

                    return true
                else
                    return false
                end
            end
            function Character.Char.initBladeRefs()
                if not isfolder_() then
                    return
                end
                local Character2 = t1.value3.Character or t1.value3.CharacterAdded:Wait()
                local v121
                local function v122()
                    v121:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
                end
                v121 = Character2
                pcall(v122)
                pcall(function()
                    v121:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
                end)
                Character2 = function()
                    return Character.Char.getBlade1() ~= nil
                end
                if t1.value3:GetAttribute("Weapon") == "Spears" then
                    v122 = false
                else
                    v122 = not Character2()
                end
                if not v122 then
                    Character.Cache.setsLabel = Character.Util.safeIndex(t1.value4, "Interface", "HUD", "Main", "Top", "Blade", "Sets")
                    Character2 = not Character.Cache.setsLabel and Character.Util.safeIndex(t1.value4, "Interface", "HUD")

                    if not Character2 then
                        return
                    end

                    for _, descendant in ipairs(Character2:GetDescendants()) do
                        if descendant.Name == "Sets" and descendant:IsA("TextLabel") or descendant:IsA("TextButton") then
                            Character.Cache.setsLabel = descendant

                            break
                        end
                    end

                    return
                end
                task.wait(1)
                v122 = tick() + 5
                while true do
                    local v125 = not Character2()

                    if v125 then
                        v125 = tick() < v122
                    end

                    if not v125 then
                        break
                    end

                    task.wait(0.2)
                end
                Character.Cache.setsLabel = Character.Util.safeIndex(t1.value4, "Interface", "HUD", "Main", "Top", "Blade", "Sets")
                Character2 = not Character.Cache.setsLabel and Character.Util.safeIndex(t1.value4, "Interface", "HUD")
                if not Character2 then
                    return
                end
                for _, descendant in ipairs(Character2:GetDescendants()) do
                    if descendant.Name == "Sets" and descendant:IsA("TextLabel") or descendant:IsA("TextButton") then
                        Character.Cache.setsLabel = descendant

                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            function Character.Char.killSelf()
                task.wait(5)

                local value = select(3, Character.Char.get())

                if not value then
                    return
                end

                pcall(function()
                    value.Health = 0
                end)
            end

            Character.Nape = {}

            function Character.Nape.extend(p47)
                if not p47 then
                    return
                end

                pcall(function()
                    p47.Size = Vector3.new(60, 60, 60)
                    p47.Color = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
                    p47.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
                end)

                if table.find(Character.Cache.extendedNapes, p47) then
                    return
                end

                local extendedNapes = Character.Cache.extendedNapes

                table.insert(extendedNapes, p47)
            end
            function Character.Nape.reset(p48)
                if not p48 then
                    return
                end
            end
            function Character.Nape.applyAll()
                local Titans = workspace:FindFirstChild("Titans")

                if Titans then
                    local GetChildren = Titans.GetChildren

                    for _, v in ipairs(GetChildren(Titans)) do
                        local v134 = Character.Util.safeIndex(v, "Hitboxes", "Hit", "Nape")

                        if v134 then
                            Character.Nape.extend(v134)
                        end
                    end

                    return
                else
                    return
                end
            end
            function Character.Nape.removeAll()
                for _, extendedNape in ipairs(Character.Cache.extendedNapes) do
                    local Parent

                    if extendedNape then
                        Parent = extendedNape.Parent
                    else
                        Parent = extendedNape
                    end

                    if Parent then
                        Character.Nape.reset(extendedNape)
                    end
                end

                Character.Cache.extendedNapes = {}
            end
            function Character.Nape.pruneStale()
                local extendedNapes = {}

                for _, extendedNape in ipairs(Character.Cache.extendedNapes) do
                    local Parent

                    if extendedNape then
                        Parent = extendedNape.Parent
                    else
                        Parent = extendedNape
                    end

                    if Parent then
                        extendedNapes[#extendedNapes + 1] = extendedNape
                    end
                end

                Character.Cache.extendedNapes = extendedNapes
            end
            function Character.Nape.startMonitor()
                local Titans = workspace:FindFirstChild("Titans")

                if not Titans then
                    return
                end
            end

            Character.Target = {}

            function Character.Target.napeOf(p49)
                local Hit = not Character.Util.safeIndex(p49, "Hitboxes", "Hit", "Nape") and p49:FindFirstChild("Hit", true)

                if not Hit then
                    return Hit
                end

                Hit = Hit:FindFirstChild("Nape")

                return Hit
            end

            Character.Target._bossStamp = 0

            function Character.Target.raidBossNape()
                local now = tick()

                if now - Character.Target._bossStamp < 0.5 then
                    now = Character.Target._bossNape

                    if now and (now.Parent and now) then
                        return now
                    end

                    now = nil

                    return now
                else
                    Character.Target._bossStamp = now
                    Character.Target._bossNape = nil
                    now = workspace:GetAttribute("Type")

                    if now == "Raids" then
                        now = true
                    elseif now == "Waves" then
                        now = Character.Config.WaveKillBosses
                    else
                        now = false
                    end

                    now = now and workspace:FindFirstChild("Titans")

                    if not now then
                        return Character.Target._bossNape
                    end

                    local GetChildren = now.GetChildren

                    for _, v in ipairs(GetChildren(now)) do
                        local isModel = v:IsA("Model")

                        if isModel then
                            isModel = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                            if isModel then
                                isModel = not v.Name:match("^%x+%-%x+%-%x+%-%x+%-%x+$")

                                if isModel then
                                    isModel = v:GetAttribute("State") ~= nil and v.Name ~= "Colossal_Titan"

                                    if isModel then
                                        isModel = Character.Colossal.phase() == 1
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        if isModel then
                            local v149 = Character.Target.napeOf(v)

                            if v149 then
                                isModel = v149.Parent
                            else
                                isModel = v149
                            end

                            if isModel then
                                Character.Target._bossNape = v149

                                break
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    return Character.Target._bossNape
                end
            end
            function Character.Target.smallTitanNape(p50)
                local Titans = workspace:FindFirstChild("Titans")

                if Titans then
                    local value = select(2, Character.Char.get())
                    local GetChildren, v153, v154, v155, isModel, Parent

                    if p50 then
                        value = p50
                    else
                        if not value then
                            if value then
                                GetChildren = Titans.GetChildren
                                v153 = (1 / 0)
                                v154 = nil
                                v155 = nil

                                for _, v in ipairs(GetChildren(Titans)) do
                                    isModel = v:IsA("Model")

                                    if isModel then
                                        isModel = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and Character.Combat.titanAttackable(v)

                                        if isModel then
                                            isModel = v.Name:match("^%x+%-%x+%-%x+%-%x+%-%x+$")
                                        end
                                    end

                                    if isModel then
                                        isModel = Character.Target.napeOf(v)

                                        if isModel then
                                            Parent = isModel.Parent
                                        else
                                            Parent = isModel
                                        end

                                        if Parent then
                                            Parent = (value - isModel.Position).Magnitude

                                            if Parent < v153 then
                                                v155 = v
                                                v154 = isModel
                                                v153 = Parent
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end

                                return v154, v155
                            else
                                return nil
                            end

                            return
                        end

                        value = value.Position
                    end

                    if value then
                        GetChildren = Titans.GetChildren
                        v153 = (1 / 0)
                        v154 = nil
                        v155 = nil

                        for _, v in ipairs(GetChildren(Titans)) do
                            isModel = v:IsA("Model")

                            if isModel then
                                isModel = v:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and Character.Combat.titanAttackable(v)

                                if isModel then
                                    isModel = v.Name:match("^%x+%-%x+%-%x+%-%x+%-%x+$")
                                end
                            end

                            if isModel then
                                isModel = Character.Target.napeOf(v)

                                if isModel then
                                    Parent = isModel.Parent
                                else
                                    Parent = isModel
                                end

                                if Parent then
                                    Parent = (value - isModel.Position).Magnitude

                                    if Parent < v153 then
                                        v155 = v
                                        v154 = isModel
                                        v153 = Parent
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        return v154, v155
                    else
                        return nil
                    end

                    return
                else
                    return nil
                end
            end

            Character.Target.BOSS_HP_NAMES = {
				"Defend_Eren",
				"Armored_Boss",
				"Female_Boss",
				"Colossal_Boss"
			}
            Character.Target._bossHpStamp = 0
            Character.Target._bossHpPct = nil

            function Character.Target.raidBossHpPct()
                local now = tick()

                if now - Character.Target._bossHpStamp < 0.4 then
                    return Character.Target._bossHpPct
                else
                    Character.Target._bossHpStamp = now
                    Character.Target._bossHpPct = nil
                    now = Character.Util.safeIndex(workspace, "Unclimbable", "Objective")

                    if now then
                        local v163
                        for _, bossHpName in ipairs(Character.Target.BOSS_HP_NAMES) do
                            local Humanoid = now:FindFirstChild(bossHpName)

                            if Humanoid then
                                local attribute
                                local v168 = Humanoid:FindFirstChild("Health")
                                local Value
                                local isNumberValue
                                if v168 then
                                    isNumberValue = v168:IsA("NumberValue")
                                else
                                    isNumberValue = v168
                                end
                                if isNumberValue then
                                    Value = v168.Value
                                    attribute = v168:GetAttribute("Max_Health")
                                end
                                if not Value then
                                    Humanoid = Humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                                    if Humanoid then
                                        Value = Humanoid.Health
                                        attribute = Humanoid.MaxHealth
                                    end
                                end
                                if Value then
                                    if attribute then
                                        if attribute > 0 then
                                            Humanoid = Value > 0
                                        else
                                            Humanoid = false
                                        end
                                    else
                                        Humanoid = attribute
                                    end
                                else
                                    Humanoid = Value
                                end
                                if Humanoid then
                                    Humanoid = Value / attribute * 100

                                    if not v163 or Humanoid < v163 then
                                        v163 = Humanoid
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        Character.Target._bossHpPct = v163

                        return v163
                    else
                        return nil
                    end

                    return
                end
            end

            Character.Target.OBJ_PRIORITY_RADIUS = 1000
            Character.Target.objStamp = 0
            Character.Target.objPosCache = nil
            Character.Target.objPrev = nil
            Character.Target.objPrevStamp = 0
            Character.Target.objMoving = false
            Character.Target.focusInst = nil
            Character.Target.titanPosPrev = setmetatable({}, {
				["__mode"] = "k"
			})

            function Character.Target.objectivePositions()
                local now = tick()
                local objPosCache = Character.Target.objPosCache
                if objPosCache then
                    objPosCache = now - Character.Target.objStamp < 0.5
                end
                if objPosCache then
                    return Character.Target.objPosCache
                end
                objPosCache = {}
                local function objMoving(p51, _)
                    if not p51 then
                        return
                    end
                end
                local Unclimbable = workspace:FindFirstChild("Unclimbable")
                local Objective
                if Unclimbable then
                    Objective = Unclimbable:FindFirstChild("Objective")
                else
                    Objective = Unclimbable
                end
                objMoving(Objective, function(p52)
                    return p52.Name ~= "Waves"
                end)
                local u176
                objMoving(Unclimbable, function(p53)
                    local v177 = p53.Name:lower()

                    return v177:match("^supplies_c") or v177:match("^thunderspear_supplies") or v177 == "plane"
                end)
                Unclimbable = function()
                    for _, v in ipairs(t1.value1.CS:GetTagged("TS_Towers")) do
                        local Parent = v.Parent

                        if Parent then
                            Parent = v.Name:lower():match("^watchtower_%d")
                        end

                        if Parent then
                            u176 = v

                            return
                        end
                    end
                end
                u176 = nil
                pcall(Unclimbable)
                objMoving(workspace, function(p54)
                    local v181 = p54.Name:lower() ~= "escort" and u176

                    if not v181 then
                        return v181
                    end

                    v181 = p54 == u176

                    return v181
                end)
                if #objPosCache > 0 then
                    objMoving = Character.Target.objPrev

                    if objMoving then
                        objMoving = now - Character.Target.objPrevStamp >= 0.3
                    end

                    if objMoving then
                        objMoving = Character.Target.objPrev
                        Unclimbable = math.min(#objMoving, #objPosCache)
                        Objective = 0

                        local n2 = 1
                        local v183 = false
                        local v184 = false

                        while true do
                            Objective = Objective + n2

                            local v185 = ((not v183 or Unclimbable > Objective) and true or false) and not v183

                            if v185 then
                                v185 = Objective <= Unclimbable
                            end

                            if not v185 then
                                break
                            end

                            if (objMoving[Objective].pos - objPosCache[Objective].pos).Magnitude > 4 then
                                v184 = true

                                break
                            end
                        end

                        objMoving = #objMoving ~= #objPosCache and true or v184
                        Character.Target.objMoving = objMoving
                        objMoving = Character.Target
                        Unclimbable = Character.Target
                        objMoving.objPrev = objPosCache
                        Unclimbable.objPrevStamp = now
                    else
                        if Character.Target.objPrev then
                            objMoving = Character.Target
                            Unclimbable = Character.Target
                            objMoving.objPosCache = objPosCache
                            Unclimbable.objStamp = now

                            return objPosCache
                        end

                        objMoving = Character.Target
                        Unclimbable = Character.Target
                        objMoving.objPrev = objPosCache
                        Unclimbable.objPrevStamp = now
                    end
                else
                    objMoving = Character.Target
                    Unclimbable = Character.Target
                    objMoving.objMoving = false
                    Unclimbable.objPrev = nil
                end
                objMoving = Character.Target
                Unclimbable = Character.Target
                objMoving.objPosCache = objPosCache
                Unclimbable.objStamp = now

                return objPosCache
            end

            makefolder_ = function(p55)
                local ok, result = pcall(function()
                    local Health = p55:FindFirstChild("Health")
                    local isValueBase

                    if Health then
                        isValueBase = Health:IsA("ValueBase")
                    else
                        isValueBase = Health
                    end

                    if isValueBase then
                        return tonumber(Health.Value)
                    else
                        return nil
                    end
                end)

                return ok and result and result or nil
            end

            function Character.Target.movingObjective()
                local v190 = Character.Target.objectivePositions()
                if #v190 == 0 then
                    return nil, false
                end
                local value, v192, v193 = ipairs(v190)
                local pos
                while true do
                    local v195

                    v193, v195 = value(v192, v193)

                    if not v193 then
                        break
                    end

                    if v195.inst == Character.Target.focusInst then
                        pos = v195.pos

                        break
                    end
                end
                if pos then
                    return pos, Character.Target.objMoving
                end
                value = select(2, Character.Char.get())
                pos = v190[1].pos
                if not value then
                    return pos, Character.Target.objMoving
                end
                v193 = (1 / 0)
                for _, v in ipairs(v190) do
                    local Magnitude = (value.Position - v.pos).Magnitude

                    if Magnitude < v193 then
                        pos = v.pos
                        v193 = Magnitude
                    end
                end

                return pos, Character.Target.objMoving
            end
            function Character.Target.isValidTarget(p56, p57)
                local Parent = p56 and p56.Parent

                if Parent then
                    if p57 then
                        Parent = p57.Parent
                    else
                        Parent = p57
                    end
                end

                if not Parent then
                    return false
                end

                Parent = Character.Colossal and Character.Colossal.active

                if Parent then
                    Parent = Character.Colossal.active()
                end

                if Parent then
                    if p56 == Character.Colossal.boss() then
                        return Character.Colossal.phase() == 2
                    end

                    Parent = Character.Colossal.erenPos()

                    if not Parent then
                        return not Parent
                    end

                    Parent = (p57.Position - Parent).Magnitude > Character.Colossal.EREN_GUARD_RADIUS

                    return not Parent
                else
                    Parent = Character.Thunder and Character.Thunder.defendingSuppliesActive

                    if Parent then
                        Parent = Character.Thunder.defendingSuppliesActive()
                    end

                    if not Parent then
                        return true
                    end

                    Parent = Character.Thunder.supplyPos()

                    if not Parent then
                        return not Parent
                    end

                    Parent = (p57.Position - Parent).Magnitude > Character.Thunder.SUPPLY_GUARD_RADIUS

                    return not Parent
                end
            end
            function Character.Target.nearest()
                local now = tick()
                local nearestTitan = Character.Cache.nearestTitan
                local value, Cache, OBJ_PRIORITY_RADIUS, GetChildren, v206, t9, v208, v209, v210, v211, Humanoid, Position

                if not nearestTitan then
                    if not nearestTitan then
                        nearestTitan = workspace:FindFirstChild("Titans")
                        value = select(2, Character.Char.get())

                        if nearestTitan and value then
                            Cache = Character.Target.objectivePositions()
                            OBJ_PRIORITY_RADIUS = Character.Target.OBJ_PRIORITY_RADIUS
                            GetChildren = nearestTitan.GetChildren
                            nearestTitan, GetChildren, v206 = ipairs(GetChildren(nearestTitan))
                            t9 = {}
                            v208 = (1 / 0)
                            v209 = nil
                            v210 = nil

                            while true do
                                v206, v211 = nearestTitan(GetChildren, v206)

                                if not v206 then
                                    break
                                end

                                Humanoid = v211:IsA("Model") and v211:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                                if Humanoid then
                                    Humanoid = Character.Combat.titanAttackable(v211)
                                end

                                if Humanoid then
                                    Humanoid = Character.Target.napeOf(v211)

                                    if Humanoid then
                                        Position = Character.Target.isValidTarget(v211, Humanoid)
                                    else
                                        Position = Humanoid
                                    end

                                    if Position then
                                        Position = Humanoid.Position
                                        t9[#t9 + 1] = {
											["titan"] = v211,
											["nape"] = Humanoid,
											["pos"] = Position
										}
                                        Position = (value.Position - Position).Magnitude

                                        if Position >= v208 then
                                            Humanoid = v210
                                            v211 = v209
                                            Position = v208
                                        end
                                    else
                                        Humanoid = v210
                                        v211 = v209
                                        Position = v208
                                    end
                                else
                                    Humanoid = v210
                                    v211 = v209
                                    Position = v208
                                end

                                v210 = Humanoid
                                v209 = v211
                                v208 = Position
                            end

                            if not (#Cache > 0) then
                                Character.Target.focusInst = nil
                                nearestTitan = Character.Cache
                                value = Character.Cache
                                Cache = Character.Cache
                                nearestTitan.nearestTitan = v209
                                value.nearestNape = v210
                                Cache.nearestStamp = now

                                return v209, v210
                            end

                            return
                        else
                            return nil, nil
                        end

                        return
                    end

                    return
                end

                nearestTitan = now - Character.Cache.nearestStamp < 0.2

                if not nearestTitan then
                    nearestTitan = workspace:FindFirstChild("Titans")
                    value = select(2, Character.Char.get())

                    if nearestTitan and value then
                        Cache = Character.Target.objectivePositions()
                        OBJ_PRIORITY_RADIUS = Character.Target.OBJ_PRIORITY_RADIUS
                        GetChildren = nearestTitan.GetChildren
                        nearestTitan, GetChildren, v206 = ipairs(GetChildren(nearestTitan))
                        t9 = {}
                        v208 = (1 / 0)
                        v209 = nil
                        v210 = nil

                        while true do
                            v206, v211 = nearestTitan(GetChildren, v206)

                            if not v206 then
                                break
                            end

                            Humanoid = v211:IsA("Model") and v211:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                            if Humanoid then
                                Humanoid = Character.Combat.titanAttackable(v211)
                            end

                            if Humanoid then
                                Humanoid = Character.Target.napeOf(v211)

                                if Humanoid then
                                    Position = Character.Target.isValidTarget(v211, Humanoid)
                                else
                                    Position = Humanoid
                                end

                                if Position then
                                    Position = Humanoid.Position
                                    t9[#t9 + 1] = {
										["titan"] = v211,
										["nape"] = Humanoid,
										["pos"] = Position
									}
                                    Position = (value.Position - Position).Magnitude

                                    if Position >= v208 then
                                        Humanoid = v210
                                        v211 = v209
                                        Position = v208
                                    end
                                else
                                    Humanoid = v210
                                    v211 = v209
                                    Position = v208
                                end
                            else
                                Humanoid = v210
                                v211 = v209
                                Position = v208
                            end

                            v210 = Humanoid
                            v209 = v211
                            v208 = Position
                        end

                        if not (#Cache > 0) then
                            Character.Target.focusInst = nil
                            nearestTitan = Character.Cache
                            value = Character.Cache
                            Cache = Character.Cache
                            nearestTitan.nearestTitan = v209
                            value.nearestNape = v210
                            Cache.nearestStamp = now

                            return v209, v210
                        end

                        return
                    else
                        return nil, nil
                    end

                    return
                end
            end
            function Character.Target.update()
                local v214, v215 = Character.Target.nearest()

                if v214 == Character.Runtime.currentTitan then
                    Character.Runtime.currentTitan = v214
                    Character.Runtime.nape = v215

                    return
                end

                Character.Runtime.bossHitboxRotIdx = 0
                Character.Runtime.currentTitan = v214
                Character.Runtime.nape = v215
            end

            Character.Move = {}
            Character.Move.dest = nil
            Character.Move.face = nil
            Character.Move._conn = nil
            Character.Move.ARRIVE = 3
            makefolder_ = function()
                if Character.Move._conn then
                    return
                end
            end

            function Character.Move.to(p58, p59, p60)
                if typeof(p59) ~= "Vector3" then
                    return
                end

                makefolder_()
                Character.Move.dest = p59

                local Move = Character.Move

                if typeof(p60) ~= "Vector3" then
                    p60 = false
                end

                Move.face = p60 or nil

                if p58 then
                    Move = p58.Anchored
                else
                    Move = p58
                end

                if not Move then
                    return
                end

                p58.Anchored = false
            end
            function Character.Move.cancel()
                Character.Move.dest = nil
                Character.Move.face = nil

                local value = select(2, Character.Char.get())

                if not value then
                    return
                end

                pcall(function()
                    value.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end)
                pcall(function()
                    value.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
                end)
                value.Anchored = false
            end
            function Character.Move.hold(p61)
                Character.Move.dest = nil

                if not p61 then
                    return
                end

                p61.Anchored = true
            end

            Character.Combat = {}
            Character.Combat.AUTO_RELOAD_SKILL = "74"

            function Character.Combat.hasAutoReloadSkill()
                local unlockedSkills = Character.Stats.unlockedSkills

                if type(unlockedSkills) == "table" then
                    unlockedSkills = unlockedSkills[Character.Combat.AUTO_RELOAD_SKILL] == true
                else
                    unlockedSkills = false
                end

                return unlockedSkills
            end
            function Character.Combat.titanAttackable(p62)
                if p62 then
                    local attribute = p62:GetAttribute("State")

                    return attribute ~= nil and attribute ~= "Roar" and attribute ~= "HeatWave"
                else
                    return false
                end
            end
            function Character.Combat.hasTarget(p63)
                local value = select(2, Character.Char.get())
                if not value then
                    return nil
                end
            end
            function Character.Combat.napeNear(p64, p65)
                local Titans = workspace:FindFirstChild("Titans")

                if Titans then
                    local v223
                    for _, child in ipairs(Titans:GetChildren()) do
                        local Humanoid = child:IsA("Model") and child:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                        if Humanoid then
                            Humanoid = Character.Combat.titanAttackable(child)
                        end

                        if Humanoid then
                            local v227 = Character.Target.napeOf(child)

                            if v227 then
                                Humanoid = (p64 - v227.Position).Magnitude

                                if Humanoid <= p65 then
                                    v223 = v227
                                    p65 = Humanoid
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    return v223
                else
                    return nil
                end
            end
            function Character.Combat.chaseHold(p66, p67, p68)
                local v228 = Character.Combat.napeNear(p66, p67 or 1000)
                local Parent

                if v228 then
                    Parent = v228.Parent
                else
                    Parent = v228
                end

                if Parent then
                    return v228.Position + Vector3.new(0, p68 or Character.Config.HoverHeight, 0)
                else
                    return p66
                end
            end
            function Character.Combat.shiftSlot()
                Character.DataCopy.fetch()

                return Character.Runtime.shiftSlot
            end

            Character.Combat.LOC_SKILLS = {
				["164"] = "vec",
				["165"] = "tbl",
				["301"] = "vec"
			}

            function Character.Combat.fireSkill(p69, p70, p71)
                local Remotes = t1.value1.RS:FindFirstChild("Assets") and t1.value1.RS.Assets:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
                local v231

                if not Remotes then
                    if Remotes then
                        if p70 then
                            v231 = p71 and ({ p70 } or p70) or p70
                        else
                            v231 = nil
                        end

                        Character.Remote.invoke(Remotes, "S_Skills", "Usage", p69, nil, v231)

                        return
                    else
                        return
                    end

                    return
                end

                Remotes = t1.value1.RS.Assets.Remotes:FindFirstChild("GET")

                if Remotes then
                    if p70 then
                        v231 = p71 and ({ p70 } or p70) or p70
                    else
                        v231 = nil
                    end

                    Character.Remote.invoke(Remotes, "S_Skills", "Usage", p69, nil, v231)

                    return
                else
                    return
                end
            end
            function Character.Combat.humanSkillSlots()
                Character.DataCopy.fetch()

                return Character.Runtime.humanSkillSlots
            end
            function Character.Combat.multiHitRadius()
                local MultiHitRadius = Character.Config.MultiHitRadius

                return tonumber(MultiHitRadius) or 250
            end
            function Character.Combat.pickBossHitbox(p72, p73)
                local v233, v234, v235 = ipairs(p72:GetChildren())
                local t10 = {}

                while true do
                    local v237

                    v235, v237 = v233(v234, v235)

                    if not v235 then
                        break
                    end

                    local isBasePart = v237:IsA("BasePart")

                    if isBasePart then
                        isBasePart = v237.Name ~= "Nape"
                    end

                    if isBasePart then
                        t10[#t10 + 1] = v237
                    end
                end

                if #t10 == 0 then
                    return p72:FindFirstChild("Nape")
                else
                    if p73 < 5 then
                        return t10[p73 % #t10 + 1]
                    else
                        v233 = p73 % 10

                        if v233 < 5 then
                            return t10[v233 % #t10 + 1]
                        else
                            return p72:FindFirstChild("Nape")
                        end

                        return
                    end

                    return
                end
            end
            function Character.Combat.timeDiff()
                return math.random(100, 800) / 1000
            end
            function Character.Combat.BV()
                return math.random(200, 400)
            end
            function Character.Combat.attack()
                local nape = Character.Runtime.nape

                if not nape then
                    return
                end

                local value = select(2, Character.Char.get())

                if not value then
                    return
                end

                local v241 = Character.Util.safeIndex(nape, "Parent", "Parent", "Parent")

                if not Character.Combat.titanAttackable(v241) then
                    return
                end

                local bossHover = Character.Runtime.bossHover

                if bossHover then
                    bossHover = workspace:GetAttribute("Objective") == "Colossal Titan"
                end

                if (bossHover and (1 / 0) or ((Character.Runtime.objectiveMode or Character.Runtime.bossHover) and 1000 or Character.Config.HoverHeight + 50)) < (value.Position - nape.Position).Magnitude then
                    return
                end

                bossHover = tick()

                if bossHover - Character.Runtime.attackBlockedTick < 4 then
                    return
                end

                if Character.Runtime.attackCombo >= 3 then
                    if bossHover - Character.Runtime.lastComboTick < 1 then
                        return
                    end

                    Character.Runtime.attackCombo = 0
                end

                if bossHover - Character.Runtime.lastAttackTick < 0.5 then
                    return
                end

                local v243 = workspace:GetAttribute("Objective") == "Stall"
                local Name = v241 and (v241.Name or "") or ""

                v243 = not v243

                if v243 then
                    if Name == "" then
                        v243 = false
                    else
                        v243 = not Name:match("^%x+%-%x+%-%x+%-%x+%-%x+$")
                    end
                end

                if v243 then
                    Name = bossHover - Character.Runtime.lastBossBladeAttackTick < 1.5
                else
                    Name = v243
                end

                if Name then
                    return
                end

                Name = Character.Runtime.lastAttackTick

                local attackCombo = Character.Runtime.attackCombo
                local lastComboTick = Character.Runtime.lastComboTick

                Character.Runtime.lastAttackTick = bossHover

                if v243 then
                    Character.Runtime.lastBossBladeAttackTick = bossHover
                end

                Character.Runtime.attackCombo = Character.Runtime.attackCombo + 1
                Character.Runtime.lastComboTick = bossHover
                v243 = t1.value3:GetAttribute("Shifting") == true

                local v247 = not v243

                if v247 then
                    v247 = t1.value3:GetAttribute("Weapon") == "Spears"
                end

                if v247 then
                    if bossHover - Character.Runtime.lastSpearTick < Character.Runtime.spearGap then
                        Character.Runtime.lastAttackTick = Name
                        Character.Runtime.attackCombo = attackCombo
                        Character.Runtime.lastComboTick = lastComboTick

                        return
                    end

                    Character.Runtime.lastSpearTick = bossHover
                    Character.Runtime.spearGap = 0.8 + math.random() * 0.2
                    bossHover = Character.Util.safeIndex(t1.value4, "Interface", "HUD", "Main", "Top", "7", "Spears", "Spears")

                    if bossHover then
                        bossHover = bossHover.Text
                        bossHover = tostring(bossHover)
                        bossHover = tonumber(bossHover:match("^%s*(%d+)")) or 0
                    else
                        bossHover = 0
                    end

                    if bossHover <= 0 then
                        v243 = not Character.Config.InfiniteSpear
                    else
                        v243 = false
                    end

                    if v243 then
                        return
                    end

                    v243 = nape.Position.X .. "," .. nape.Position.Y .. "," .. nape.Position.Z
                    Name = workspace:GetAttribute("Objective") == "Stall"
                    bossHover = bossHover > 0 and math.min(bossHover, 8) or 1
                    bossHover = tostring(bossHover)
                    attackCombo = v241.Name:match("^%x+%-%x+%-%x+%-%x+%-%x+$")
                    lastComboTick = not Name

                    if lastComboTick then
                        attackCombo = attackCombo ~= nil
                        lastComboTick = not attackCombo
                    end

                    if lastComboTick then
                        value = Character.Util.safeIndex(v241, "Hitboxes", "Hit")

                        if value then
                            value = Character.Combat.pickBossHitbox(value, Character.Runtime.bossHitboxRotIdx) or nape
                        else
                            value = nape
                        end

                        nape = value and value.Position or nape.Position
                        v243 = nape.X .. "," .. nape.Y .. "," .. nape.Z
                        nape = Character.Config.BossBurst or 5
                        nape = math.clamp(nape, 1, 10)
                        v241 = 1
                        Name = 1
                        attackCombo = false

                        while true do
                            v241 = v241 + Name
                            lastComboTick = ((not attackCombo or nape > v241) and true or false) and not attackCombo

                            if lastComboTick then
                                lastComboTick = v241 <= nape
                            end

                            if not lastComboTick then
                                break
                            end

                            lastComboTick = Vector3.new(math.random(-5, 5), math.random(-2, 2), math.random(-5, 5))
                            lastComboTick = value.Position + lastComboTick
                            v243 = v243 .. "\31" .. lastComboTick.X .. "," .. lastComboTick.Y .. "," .. lastComboTick.Z
                        end

                        Character.Runtime.bossHitboxRotIdx = Character.Runtime.bossHitboxRotIdx + 1
                    else
                        if Name or not Character.Config.MultiHitEnabled then
                            Name = 1
                        else
                            Name = Character.Config.MultiHit or 1
                            Name = math.max(1, Name) or 1
                        end

                        if not (Name > 1) then
                            nape = t1.value1.RS.Assets.Remotes.GET
                            value = t1.value1.RS.Assets.Remotes.POST
                            Character.Remote.invoke(nape, "Spears", "S_Fire", bossHover)

                            for match in string.gmatch(v243, "([^\31]+)") do
                                match, v243, Name = match:match("([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+)")

                                if match then
                                    Character.Remote.fire(value, "Spears", "S_Explode", Vector3.new(tonumber(match), tonumber(v243), (tonumber(Name))), Character.Combat.timeDiff())
                                end
                            end

                            return
                        end

                        attackCombo = workspace:FindFirstChild("Titans")
                        value = value.Position
                        lastComboTick = {}

                        if attackCombo then
                            for _, child in ipairs(attackCombo:GetChildren()) do
                                v337 = child ~= v241

                                if v337 then
                                    v337 = child:IsA("Model") and child:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                                    if v337 then
                                        v337 = Character.Combat.titanAttackable(child)
                                    end
                                end

                                if v337 then
                                    v337 = Character.Util.safeIndex(child, "Hitboxes", "Hit", "Nape")
                                    child = v337 and Character.Target.isValidTarget(child, v337)

                                    if child then
                                        child = (v337.Position - nape.Position).Magnitude <= Character.Combat.multiHitRadius()
                                    end

                                    if child then
                                        lastComboTick[#lastComboTick + 1] = {
											["pos"] = v337.Position,
											["dist"] = (value - v337.Position).Magnitude
										}
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            table.sort(lastComboTick, function(p74, p75)
                                return p74.dist < p75.dist
                            end)
                        end

                        nape = math.min
                        value = Name - 1

                        for i = 1, nape(#lastComboTick, value) do
                            Name = lastComboTick[i].pos
                            v243 = v243 .. "\31" .. Name.X .. "," .. Name.Y .. "," .. Name.Z
                        end
                    end

                    nape = t1.value1.RS.Assets.Remotes.GET
                    value = t1.value1.RS.Assets.Remotes.POST
                    Character.Remote.invoke(nape, "Spears", "S_Fire", bossHover)

                    for match in string.gmatch(v243, "([^\31]+)") do
                        match, v243, Name = match:match("([^,]+),([^,]+),([^,]+)")

                        if match then
                            Character.Remote.fire(value, "Spears", "S_Explode", Vector3.new(tonumber(match), tonumber(v243), (tonumber(Name))), Character.Combat.timeDiff())
                        end
                    end

                    return
                end

                v241 = value:FindFirstChild("BV")

                if v241 then
                    v241 = v241.Velocity.Magnitude
                end

                if v243 then
                    t1.value7("TitanMastery: M1 punch (Slash + Register) on nape")
                end

                v241 = workspace:FindFirstChild("Titans")

                if not v241 then
                    return
                end

                v241 = v241:GetChildren()
                bossHover = Character.Util.safeIndex(nape, "Parent", "Parent", "Parent")
                v243, Name, attackCombo = ipairs(v241)
                lastComboTick = nil

                while true do
                    attackCombo, v247 = v243(Name, attackCombo)

                    if not attackCombo then
                        attackCombo = lastComboTick

                        break
                    end

                    if v247 == bossHover then
                        break
                    end
                end

                if not attackCombo then
                    return
                end

                v243 = workspace:GetAttribute("Objective") == "Stall"
                Name = bossHover.Name:match("^%x+%-%x+%-%x+%-%x+%-%x+$") ~= nil
                bossHover = Character.Util.safeIndex(bossHover, "Hitboxes", "Hit")
                Name = not (v243 or Name)

                if Name then
                    Name = bossHover ~= nil
                end

                bossHover = not v243

                if bossHover then
                    bossHover = Character.Config.MultiHitEnabled
                end

                if bossHover then
                    bossHover = Character.Config.MultiHit or 1
                    bossHover = math.max(1, bossHover)
                end

                v243 = { attackCombo }
                bossHover = bossHover or 1

                if not (bossHover > 1) then
                    nape = table.concat(v243, "\31")
                    value = Character.Config.BossBurst or 5
                    value = math.clamp(value, 1, 10)
                    bossHover = t1.value1.RS.Assets.Remotes.POST
                    Character.Remote.fire(bossHover, "Attacks", "Slash", true)

                    if (Name and 1 or 0) == 1 then
                        nape, v243, Name = string.gmatch(nape, "([^\31]+)")
                        attackCombo = nil

                        while true do
                            Name = nape(v243, Name)

                            if not Name then
                                break
                            end

                            attackCombo = attackCombo or tonumber(Name)
                        end

                        if attackCombo then
                            attackCombo = v241[attackCombo]
                        end

                        nape = attackCombo and attackCombo.Parent

                        if nape then
                            nape = attackCombo:FindFirstChild("Hitboxes")
                        end

                        if nape then
                            nape = nape:FindFirstChild("Hit")
                        end

                        if nape then
                            nape = Character.Combat.pickBossHitbox(nape, Character.Runtime.bossHitboxRotIdx)
                        end

                        if not nape then
                            Character.Remote.fire(bossHover, "Attacks", "Slash", false)

                            return
                        end

                        for i = 1, value do
                            Character.Remote.fire(bossHover, "Hitboxes", "Register", nape, Character.Combat.BV(), Character.Combat.timeDiff())
                        end

                        Character.Runtime.bossHitboxRotIdx = Character.Runtime.bossHitboxRotIdx + 1
                    else
                        for match in string.gmatch(nape, "([^\31]+)") do
                            match = v241[tonumber(match)]

                            if match then
                                Name = match.Parent
                            else
                                Name = match
                            end

                            if Name then
                                match = match:FindFirstChild("Hitboxes")

                                if match then
                                    match = match:FindFirstChild("Hit")
                                end

                                if match then
                                    match = match:FindFirstChild("Nape")
                                end

                                if match then
                                    Character.Remote.fire(bossHover, "Hitboxes", "Register", match, Character.Combat.BV(), Character.Combat.timeDiff())
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    Character.Remote.fire(bossHover, "Attacks", "Slash", false)

                    return
                end

                value = value.Position

                local v255

                lastComboTick, v247, v255 = ipairs(v241)

                local t11 = {}

                while true do
                    local v257

                    v255, v257 = lastComboTick(v247, v255)

                    if not v255 then
                        break
                    end

                    local v258 = v255 ~= attackCombo

                    if v258 then
                        v258 = v257:IsA("Model") and v257:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

                        if v258 then
                            v258 = Character.Combat.titanAttackable(v257)
                        end
                    end

                    if v258 then
                        v258 = Character.Util.safeIndex(v257, "Hitboxes", "Hit", "Nape")
                        v257 = v258 and Character.Target.isValidTarget(v257, v258)

                        if v257 then
                            v257 = (v258.Position - nape.Position).Magnitude <= Character.Combat.multiHitRadius()
                        end

                        if v257 then
                            t11[#t11 + 1] = {
								["idx"] = v255,
								["dist"] = (value - v258.Position).Magnitude
							}
                        end
                    end
                end

                table.sort(t11, function(p76, p77)
                    return p76.dist < p77.dist
                end)

                for _, v in ipairs(t11) do
                    if bossHover <= #v243 then
                        nape = table.concat(v243, "\31")
                        value = Character.Config.BossBurst or 5
                        value = math.clamp(value, 1, 10)
                        bossHover = t1.value1.RS.Assets.Remotes.POST
                        Character.Remote.fire(bossHover, "Attacks", "Slash", true)

                        if (Name and 1 or 0) == 1 then
                            nape, v243, Name = string.gmatch(nape, "([^\31]+)")
                            v = nil

                            while true do
                                Name = nape(v243, Name)

                                if not Name then
                                    break
                                end

                                v = v or tonumber(Name)
                            end

                            if v then
                                v = v241[v]
                            end

                            nape = v and v.Parent

                            if nape then
                                nape = v:FindFirstChild("Hitboxes")
                            end

                            if nape then
                                nape = nape:FindFirstChild("Hit")
                            end

                            if nape then
                                nape = Character.Combat.pickBossHitbox(nape, Character.Runtime.bossHitboxRotIdx)
                            end

                            if not nape then
                                Character.Remote.fire(bossHover, "Attacks", "Slash", false)

                                return
                            end

                            for i = 1, value do
                                Character.Remote.fire(bossHover, "Hitboxes", "Register", nape, Character.Combat.BV(), Character.Combat.timeDiff())
                            end

                            Character.Runtime.bossHitboxRotIdx = Character.Runtime.bossHitboxRotIdx + 1
                        else
                            for match in string.gmatch(nape, "([^\31]+)") do
                                match = v241[tonumber(match)]

                                if match then
                                    Name = match.Parent
                                else
                                    Name = match
                                end

                                if Name then
                                    match = match:FindFirstChild("Hitboxes")

                                    if match then
                                        match = match:FindFirstChild("Hit")
                                    end

                                    if match then
                                        match = match:FindFirstChild("Nape")
                                    end

                                    if match then
                                        Character.Remote.fire(bossHover, "Hitboxes", "Register", match, Character.Combat.BV(), Character.Combat.timeDiff())
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        Character.Remote.fire(bossHover, "Attacks", "Slash", false)

                        return
                    end

                    v243[#v243 + 1] = v.idx
                end

                nape = table.concat(v243, "\31")
                value = Character.Config.BossBurst or 5
                value = math.clamp(value, 1, 10)
                bossHover = t1.value1.RS.Assets.Remotes.POST
                Character.Remote.fire(bossHover, "Attacks", "Slash", true)

                if (Name and 1 or 0) == 1 then
                    nape, v243, Name = string.gmatch(nape, "([^\31]+)")
                    attackCombo = nil

                    while true do
                        Name = nape(v243, Name)

                        if not Name then
                            break
                        end

                        attackCombo = attackCombo or tonumber(Name)
                    end

                    if attackCombo then
                        attackCombo = v241[attackCombo]
                    end

                    nape = attackCombo and attackCombo.Parent

                    if nape then
                        nape = attackCombo:FindFirstChild("Hitboxes")
                    end

                    if nape then
                        nape = nape:FindFirstChild("Hit")
                    end

                    if nape then
                        nape = Character.Combat.pickBossHitbox(nape, Character.Runtime.bossHitboxRotIdx)
                    end

                    if not nape then
                        Character.Remote.fire(bossHover, "Attacks", "Slash", false)

                        return
                    end

                    for i = 1, value do
                        Character.Remote.fire(bossHover, "Hitboxes", "Register", nape, Character.Combat.BV(), Character.Combat.timeDiff())
                    end

                    Character.Runtime.bossHitboxRotIdx = Character.Runtime.bossHitboxRotIdx + 1
                else
                    for match in string.gmatch(nape, "([^\31]+)") do
                        match = v241[tonumber(match)]

                        if match then
                            Name = match.Parent
                        else
