                            Name = match
                        end

                        if Name then
                            match = match:FindFirstChild("Hitboxes")

                            if match then
                                match = match:FindFirstChild("Hit")
                            end

                            if match then
                                match = match:FindFirstChild("Nape")
                            end

                            if match then
                                Character.Remote.fire(bossHover, "Hitboxes", "Register", match, Character.Combat.BV(), Character.Combat.timeDiff())
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                Character.Remote.fire(bossHover, "Attacks", "Slash", false)
            end
            function Character.Combat.reload()
                if not Character.Config.AutoReload or Character.Runtime.isReloading then
                    return
                end

                if tick() - Character.Runtime.fullReloadCooldownTick < 4 then
                    return
                end

                if tick() - Character.Runtime.lastReloadTick < 5 then
                    return
                end

                local Character2 = Character.Char.getBlade1()

                if not Character2 or Character2.Transparency ~= 1 then
                    return
                end

                Character2 = t1.value3.Character

                if not Character2 then
                    if Character2 then
                        return
                    else
                        Character2 = Character.Cache.setsLabel and Character.Cache.setsLabel.Text or ""
                        Character2 = tonumber(Character2:match("^(%d+)"))

                        if not Character2 or Character2 <= 0 then
                            return
                        end

                        return
                    end

                    return
                end

                Character2 = Character2:GetAttribute("IFrames") ~= nil

                if Character2 then
                    return
                else
                    Character2 = Character.Cache.setsLabel and Character.Cache.setsLabel.Text or ""
                    Character2 = tonumber(Character2:match("^(%d+)"))

                    if not Character2 or Character2 <= 0 then
                        return
                    end

                    return
                end
            end
            function Character.Combat.findRefill()
                local ipairs_ = ipairs
                local workspace_ = workspace

                for _, descendant in ipairs_(workspace_:GetDescendants()) do
                    local isBasePart

                    if descendant.Name == "Refill" then
                        isBasePart = descendant:IsA("BasePart")
                    else
                        isBasePart = false
                    end

                    if isBasePart then
                        return descendant
                    end
                end

                return nil
            end
            function Character.Combat.spearFullReload()
                if not Character.Config.AutoFullReload then
                    return
                end

                local now = tick()

                if not (not Character.Cache.refill or (not Character.Cache.refill.Parent or now - Character.Runtime.lastRefillSearchTick > 10)) then
                    if Character.Cache.refill then
                        Character.Runtime.lastFullReloadTick = now
                        Character.Runtime.fullReloadCooldownTick = now
                        Character.Runtime.attackBlockedTick = now
                        Character.Actor.send("Attacks", "Reload", Character.Cache.refill)

                        return
                    else
                        return
                    end

                    return
                end

                Character.Cache.refill = Character.Combat.findRefill()
                Character.Runtime.lastRefillSearchTick = now

                if Character.Cache.refill then
                    Character.Runtime.lastFullReloadTick = now
                    Character.Runtime.fullReloadCooldownTick = now
                    Character.Runtime.attackBlockedTick = now
                    Character.Actor.send("Attacks", "Reload", Character.Cache.refill)

                    return
                else
                    return
                end
            end
            function Character.Combat.fullReload()
                if not Character.Config.AutoFullReload then
                    return
                end

                if not Character.Cache.setsLabel then
                    if Character.Runtime.bladeInitRunning then
                        return
                    end

                    Character.Runtime.bladeInitRunning = true
                    Character.Char.initBladeRefs()
                    Character.Runtime.bladeInitRunning = false

                    if not Character.Cache.setsLabel then
                        return
                    end
                end

                if Character.Cache.setsLabel.Text ~= "0 / 3" then
                    return
                end

                if not Character.Char.allSetsUsed() then
                    return
                end

                local now = Character.Char.getBlade1()

                if not now or now.Transparency ~= 1 then
                    return
                end

                now = tick()

                if not (not Character.Cache.refill or (not Character.Cache.refill.Parent or now - Character.Runtime.lastRefillSearchTick > 10)) then
                    if Character.Cache.refill then
                        Character.Runtime.lastFullReloadTick = now
                        Character.Runtime.fullReloadCooldownTick = now
                        Character.Runtime.attackBlockedTick = now
                        Character.Actor.send("Attacks", "Reload", Character.Cache.refill)

                        return
                    else
                        return
                    end

                    return
                end

                Character.Cache.refill = Character.Combat.findRefill()
                Character.Runtime.lastRefillSearchTick = now

                if Character.Cache.refill then
                    Character.Runtime.lastFullReloadTick = now
                    Character.Runtime.fullReloadCooldownTick = now
                    Character.Runtime.attackBlockedTick = now
                    Character.Actor.send("Attacks", "Reload", Character.Cache.refill)

                    return
                else
                    return
                end
            end

            Character.Perf = {}
            Character.Perf._origAtmoDensity = nil
            Character.Perf.FOG_AMBIENT_DENSITY = 0.15

            function Character.Perf.setFog(p78)
                t1.value7("Perf.setFog: remove=" .. tostring(p78))

                local function v273()
                    local Lighting = t1.value1.Lighting

                    Lighting = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")

                    local v275

                    if p78 then
                        v275 = function()
                            if not Lighting then
                                return
                            end

                            local Density = Lighting.Density

                            if not (Character.Perf.FOG_AMBIENT_DENSITY < Density) then
                                return
                            end

                            if Character.Perf._origAtmoDensity == nil then
                                Character.Perf._origAtmoDensity = Density
                            end

                            Lighting.Density = Character.Perf.FOG_AMBIENT_DENSITY
                            t1.value7("Perf.setFog: density " .. string.format("%.2f", Density) .. " normalized to " .. Character.Perf.FOG_AMBIENT_DENSITY)
                        end
                        v275()

                        if not (not Character.Conn.FogAtmoMonitor and Lighting) then
                            return
                        end
                    end

                    Character.Connection.disconnect("FogAtmoMonitor")

                    if Lighting then
                        v275 = Character.Perf._origAtmoDensity ~= nil
                    else
                        v275 = Lighting
                    end

                    if v275 then
                        Lighting.Density = Character.Perf._origAtmoDensity
                        t1.value7("Perf.setFog: Atmosphere density restored")
                    end

                    Character.Perf._origAtmoDensity = nil
                end

                pcall(v273)
            end
            function Character.Perf.applyAll()
                local value7 = t1.value7
                local v278 = isfolder_

                v278 = tostring(v278())

                local RemoveFog = Character.Config.RemoveFog

                value7("Perf.applyAll: inGame=" .. v278 .. " fog=" .. tostring(RemoveFog))

                if isfolder_() then
                    Character.Perf.setFog(Character.Config.RemoveFog)

                    return
                else
                    t1.value7("Perf.applyAll: skipped (not in game)")

                    return
                end
            end

            Character.Runtime.bladeTransparentSince = 0
            Character.Tasks.reload = Character.Task.new("Reload", function(p79)
                Character.Char.initBladeRefs()

                while p79.enabled do
                    task.wait(0.5)

                    if not p79.enabled then
                        return
                    end

                    if isfolder_() then
                        local Text, v281

                        if t1.value3:GetAttribute("Weapon") == "Spears" then
                            Text = Character.Util.safeIndex(t1.value4, "Interface", "HUD", "Main", "Top", "7", "Spears", "Spears")
                            v281 = false

                            if Text then
                                Text = Text.Text
                                Text = tostring(Text)
                                Text = tonumber(Text:match("^%s*(%d+)")) or 0
                            else
                                Text = 0
                            end

                            if Text <= 0 then
                                v281 = not Character.Config.InfiniteSpear
                            end

                            if v281 then
                                Character.Combat.spearFullReload()
                            end
                        else
                            Text = Character.Cache.setsLabel

                            if Text then
                                v281 = Character.Char.getBlade1()

                                if v281 then
                                    v281 = v281.Transparency == 1
                                end

                                if v281 then
                                    if Character.Runtime.bladeTransparentSince == 0 then
                                        Character.Runtime.bladeTransparentSince = tick()
                                    end

                                    Text = Text.Text

                                    if (tonumber(Text:match("^(%d+)")) or 0) == 0 then
                                        Character.Combat.fullReload()
                                    elseif Character.Combat.hasAutoReloadSkill() then
                                        if tick() - Character.Runtime.bladeTransparentSince > 2 then
                                            t1.value7("Reload fallback: skill 74 missed, firing Blades,Reload manually")
                                            Character.Combat.reload()
                                        end
                                    else
                                        Character.Combat.reload()
                                    end
                                else
                                    Character.Runtime.bladeTransparentSince = 0
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            makefolder_ = function()
                Character.Tasks.reload:stop()
            end
            Character.Tasks.streakWatch = Character.Task.new("StreakWatch", function(p80)
                while true do
                    if not p80.enabled then
                        return
                    end

                    task.wait(2)

                    if not p80.enabled then
                        return
                    end

                    if not (Character.Config.AutoDie and isfolder_()) then
                        continue
                    end

                    local sessionStartTick = Character.Runtime.sessionStartTick

                    if sessionStartTick > 0 and sessionStartTick < Character.Runtime.rewardedTick and true or sessionStartTick < Character.Runtime.lastFailedTick then
                        continue
                    end

                    sessionStartTick = t1.value3
                    sessionStartTick = tonumber(sessionStartTick:GetAttribute("Streak")) or (Character.Stats.streak or 0)

                    local AutoDieStreak = Character.Config.AutoDieStreak

                    AutoDieStreak = tonumber(AutoDieStreak) or 50

                    if AutoDieStreak > sessionStartTick then
                        continue
                    end

                    local function v284()
                        return Character.Features.cutsceneActive()
                    end
                    local function v285()
                        local v286 = Character.Util.safeIndex(t1.value4, "Cache", "Fullscreen_Interface", "Loading_Screen")

                        if v286 == nil then
                            v286 = false
                        else
                            v286 = v286.Visible
                        end

                        return v286
                    end

                    if v284() or v285() then
                        t1.value7("StreakWatch: streak hit but cutscene/loading active, waiting to clear before dying")

                        local v287 = tick() + 30

                        while (tick() < v287 and v284() or v285()) and p80.enabled do
                            task.wait(0.5)
                        end

                        if not p80.enabled then
                            return
                        end

                        if not (Character.Config.AutoDie and isfolder_()) then
                            continue
                        end

                        v284 = Character.Runtime.sessionStartTick

                        if v284 > 0 and v284 < Character.Runtime.rewardedTick and true or v284 < Character.Runtime.lastFailedTick then
                            continue
                        end

                        v284 = t1.value3

                        if (tonumber(v284:GetAttribute("Streak")) or (Character.Stats.streak or 0)) < AutoDieStreak then
                            continue
                        end

                        task.wait(1)
                    end

                    t1.value7("StreakWatch: streak=" .. sessionStartTick .. " >= " .. AutoDieStreak .. ", killing self")
                    readfile_("Auto Die", "Streak " .. sessionStartTick .. " dying now", 3, "x")
                    Character.Stats.dataCopyStamp = 0
                    Character.Char.killSelf()
                    task.wait(8)
                    sessionStartTick = function()
                        local Visible = Character.Util.safeIndex(t1.value4, "Interface", "Rewards")

                        if not Visible then
                            return Visible or nil
                        end

                        Visible = Visible.Visible and Visible

                        return Visible or nil
                    end
                    AutoDieStreak = tick() + 10

                    while true do
                        if true then
                            if tick() < AutoDieStreak then
                                v284 = not sessionStartTick()
                            else
                                v284 = false
                            end
                        end

                        if not v284 then
                            break
                        end

                        task.wait(0.5)

                        continue
                    end

                    if sessionStartTick() then
                        t1.value7("StreakWatch: reward screen visible clicking Retry")
                        Character.Reward.clickRetrySure()
                    else
                        t1.value7("StreakWatch: no reward screen leaving to lobby")
                        leaveToLobby(20)
                    end

                    continue
                end
            end)
            Character.Runtime.charSlotIndex = 1
            Character.Tasks.autoSelectChar = Character.Task.new("AutoSelectChar", function(p81)
                if game.PlaceId ~= Character.PLACE.MainMenu then
                    t1.value7("AutoSelectChar: not in MainMenu, stopping.")
                    p81:stop()

                    return
                end
                local charSlots = Character.Lobby.charSlots
                if not charSlots or #charSlots == 0 then
                    readfile_("Auto Select", "No slots configured.", 4, "info")
                    p81:stop()

                    return
                end
                local Functions
                local v291
                if not Functions then
                    v291 = not p81.enabled
                end
                while true do
                    task.wait(0.3)
                    v291 = t1.value3:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")

                    if v291 then
                        v291 = v291:FindFirstChild("Interface")
                    end

                    if v291 then
                        v291 = v291:FindFirstChild("Title_Screen")
                    end

                    if v291 then
                        v291 = v291:FindFirstChild("Slots")
                    end

                    local Visible

                    if v291 then
                        Visible = v291.Visible
                    else
                        Visible = v291
                    end

                    if not Visible then
                        v291 = Functions
                    end

                    if v291 or not p81.enabled then
                        break
                    end

                    Functions = v291
                end
                if not v291 then
                    t1.value7("AutoSelectChar: Slots GUI not visible")
                    readfile_("Auto Select", "Slots screen did not appear.", 4, "x-circle")
                    p81:stop()

                    return
                end
                if not (Character.Runtime.charSlotIndex > #charSlots) then
                    charSlots = charSlots[Character.Runtime.charSlotIndex]
                    Character.Runtime.charSlotIndex = Character.Runtime.charSlotIndex + 1
                    t1.value7("AutoSelectChar: selecting slot", charSlots)
                    Functions = Character.Actor.invoke("Functions", "Select", {
						["argsExpr"] = string.format("%q", charSlots),
						["mapExpr"] = "out = true",
						["timeout"] = 6
					})

                    if Functions then
                        v291 = Functions.ok
                    else
                        v291 = Functions
                    end

                    if v291 then
                        t1.value7("AutoSelectChar: selected slot", charSlots, " teleporting to Lobby")
                        task.wait(0.5)
                        Character.Actor.invoke("Functions", "Teleport", {
							["argsExpr"] = "\"Lobby\"",
							["mapExpr"] = "out = true",
							["timeout"] = 5
						})
                    else
                        t1.value7("AutoSelectChar: Select failed", Functions and Functions.err or "nil")
                        readfile_("Auto Select", "Failed to select slot " .. charSlots, 4, "x-circle")
                    end

                    p81:stop()

                    return
                end
                Character.Runtime.charSlotIndex = 1
                charSlots = charSlots[Character.Runtime.charSlotIndex]
                Character.Runtime.charSlotIndex = Character.Runtime.charSlotIndex + 1
                t1.value7("AutoSelectChar: selecting slot", charSlots)
                Functions = Character.Actor.invoke("Functions", "Select", {
					["argsExpr"] = string.format("%q", charSlots),
					["mapExpr"] = "out = true",
					["timeout"] = 6
				})
                if Functions then
                    v291 = Functions.ok
                else
                    v291 = Functions
                end
                if v291 then
                    t1.value7("AutoSelectChar: selected slot", charSlots, " teleporting to Lobby")
                    task.wait(0.5)
                    Character.Actor.invoke("Functions", "Teleport", {
						["argsExpr"] = "\"Lobby\"",
						["mapExpr"] = "out = true",
						["timeout"] = 5
					})
                else
                    t1.value7("AutoSelectChar: Select failed", Functions and Functions.err or "nil")
                    readfile_("Auto Select", "Failed to select slot " .. charSlots, 4, "x-circle")
                end
                p81:stop()
            end)
            Character.Tasks.attack = Character.Task.new("Attack", function(p82)
                local n3 = 0

                while true do
                    if not p82.enabled then
                        return
                    end

                    task.wait(0.3)

                    if not p82.enabled then
                        return
                    end

                    if workspace:GetAttribute("Rewarded") or workspace:GetAttribute("Force_End") then
                        continue
                    end

                    if Character.Features.cutsceneActive() then
                        n3 = os.clock() + 5

                        continue
                    else
                        if os.clock() < n3 then
                            continue
                        end

                        local currentTitan = Character.Runtime.currentTitan
                        local nape = Character.Runtime.nape

                        if not (currentTitan and nape and (nape.Parent and currentTitan.Parent and currentTitan:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))) then
                            continue
                        end

                        local active = Character.Colossal and Character.Colossal.active

                        if active then
                            active = Character.Colossal.active()
                        end

                        if active then
                            active = Character
                            v385 = currentTitan == Character.Colossal.boss()

                            if active.Colossal.phase() == 1 then
                                if v385 then
                                    continue
                                end

                                active = select(2, Character.Char.get())

                                if not active or active:FindFirstChild("Cannon") then
                                    continue
                                end
                            end

                            if not v385 then
                                active = Character.Colossal.erenPos()

                                if active then
                                    active = (nape.Position - active).Magnitude > Character.Colossal.EREN_GUARD_RADIUS
                                end

                                if active then
                                    continue
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        active = workspace

                        local v297 = false

                        if active:GetAttribute("Type") == "Raids" and workspace:GetAttribute("Objective") == "Attack Titan" then
                            currentTitan = true
                        elseif workspace:GetAttribute("Objective") == "Armored Titan" then
                            currentTitan = currentTitan.Name:match("^%x+%-%x+%-%x+%-%x+%-%x+$")
                        else
                            currentTitan = false
                        end

                        if currentTitan then
                            currentTitan = t1.value1.RS:FindFirstChild("Objectives")

                            if currentTitan and currentTitan:FindFirstChild("Defeat_Attack_Titan") or currentTitan:FindFirstChild("Defeat_Armored_Titan") then
                                v297 = true
                                currentTitan = Character.Target.raidBossNape()
                                active = currentTitan and currentTitan.Parent

                                if active then
                                    active = (nape.Position - currentTitan.Position).Magnitude <= 100
                                end

                                if active then
                                    v297 = false
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        if v297 then
                            continue
                        end

                        currentTitan = workspace:GetAttribute("Seconds") or 0
                        nape = workspace:GetAttribute("Type")
                        active = nape == "Missions" and Character.Config.MissionSafetyTimer or (nape == "Raids" and Character.Config.RaidSafetyTimer or nil)

                        if currentTitan ~= Character.Runtime.safetySecVal then
                            Character.Runtime.safetySecVal = currentTitan
                            Character.Runtime.safetySecStamp = tick()
                        end

                        v297 = tick() - Character.Runtime.safetySecStamp > 6
                        nape = nape == "Raids" and Character.Config.RaidBossHpHold

                        if nape then
                            if active then
                                nape = currentTitan < active
                            else
                                nape = active
                            end
                        end

                        local format, v299

                        if nape then
                            nape = Character.Target.raidBossHpPct()

                            if nape then
                                v388 = Character.Config.RaidBossHpThreshold
                                v388 = tonumber(v388) or 25
                                v388 = nape <= math.clamp(v388, 5, 50)
                            else
                                v388 = nape
                            end

                            if v388 then
                                if v297 then
                                    if tick() - Character.Runtime.bossHpChipTick < 1.5 then
                                        v388 = true
                                    else
                                        v388 = false
                                        Character.Runtime.bossHpChipTick = tick()

                                        if not Character.Runtime.bossHpNotifyTick or tick() - Character.Runtime.bossHpNotifyTick >= 10 then
                                            Character.Runtime.bossHpNotifyTick = tick()
                                            t1.value7("BossHpHold: timer frozen at", currentTitan, "boss", string.format("%.0f%%", nape), "-> slow-chipping to un-stick")
                                        end
                                    end
                                else
                                    v388 = true

                                    if not Character.Runtime.bossHpNotifyTick or tick() - Character.Runtime.bossHpNotifyTick >= 10 then
                                        Character.Runtime.bossHpNotifyTick = tick()
                                        nape = readfile_
                                        format = string.format
                                        v299 = active - currentTitan
                                        nape("Safety Timer", format("Boss at %.0f%% HP holding (%ds left)", nape, (math.ceil(v299))), 9, "shield")
                                    end
                                end

                                if v388 then
                                    nape = select(2, Character.Char.get())
                                    v388 = Character.Target.smallTitanNape

                                    if nape then
                                        nape = nape.Position
                                    end

                                    nape, v388 = v388(nape)

                                    if not (nape and v388) then
                                        continue
                                    end

                                    format = Character.Runtime
                                    v299 = Character.Runtime
                                    format.nape = nape
                                    v299.currentTitan = v388
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        nape = {
							["Slay"] = true,
							["Kill"] = true
						}

                        local t12 = {
							["Slay"] = true,
							["Kill"] = true,
							["Defend"] = true,
							["Protect"] = true,
							["Guard"] = true,
							["Protect_HQ"] = true
						}

                        if active then
                            if currentTitan < active then
                                format = not v297
                            else
                                format = false
                            end
                        else
                            format = active
                        end

                        if format then
                            v297 = workspace:GetAttribute("Objective")
                            format = t1.value1.RS:FindFirstChild("Objectives")
                            v299 = nil

                            local GetChildren

                            if format then
                                GetChildren = format.GetChildren

                                for _, v in ipairs(GetChildren(format)) do
                                    if t12[v.Name] then
                                        v299 = v

                                        break
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            if v299 then
                                t12 = v299.Value or 0
                                format = v299:GetAttribute("Requirement") or 0

                                if Character.Config.MultiHitEnabled then
                                    GetChildren = Character.Config.MultiHit or 1
                                    GetChildren = math.max(1, GetChildren) or 1
                                else
                                    GetChildren = 1
                                end

                                local t13 = {
									["Protect_HQ"] = true,
									["Guard"] = true,
									["Defend"] = true
								}
                                local v305 = false

                                if v297 == "Breach" then
                                    if v299.Name == "Protect_HQ" then
                                        if format > 1 then
                                            v305 = format - 2 <= t12
                                        else
                                            v305 = false
                                        end
                                    end
                                elseif t13[v299.Name] then
                                    if format > 1 then
                                        v305 = format - 2 <= t12
                                    else
                                        v305 = false
                                    end
                                elseif nape[v299.Name] then
                                    if format > 1 then
                                        v305 = format - GetChildren <= t12
                                    else
                                        v305 = false
                                    end
                                end

                                if v305 then
                                    if not Character.Runtime.safetyNotifyTick or tick() - Character.Runtime.safetyNotifyTick >= 10 then
                                        Character.Runtime.safetyNotifyTick = tick()
                                        nape = readfile_
                                        v297 = string.format
                                        v299 = v299.Name
                                        currentTitan = active - currentTitan
                                        nape("Safety Timer", v297("Holding %s %d/%d (%ds left)", v299, t12, format, (math.ceil(currentTitan))), 9, "clock")
                                    end

                                    continue
                                else
                                    currentTitan = t1.value3:GetAttribute("Shifting")
                                    nape = t1.value3
                                    currentTitan = currentTitan == true

                                    if nape:GetAttribute("Weapon") == "Spears" then
                                        nape = false
                                    else
                                        nape = not currentTitan
                                    end

                                    if nape then
                                        nape = Character.Char.getBlade1()

                                        if nape then
                                            nape = nape.Transparency == 1
                                        end

                                        if nape then
                                            continue
                                        end
                                    end

                                    Character.Combat.attack()

                                    if Character.Config.AutoUseSkills then
                                        nape = Character.Combat.hasTarget(500)

                                        if not currentTitan and nape then
                                            currentTitan = tick()

                                            if currentTitan - Character.Runtime.lastHumanSkillTick > 0.6 then
                                                active = Character.Combat.humanSkillSlots()

                                                if active then
                                                    v297 = #active > 0
                                                else
                                                    v297 = active
                                                end

                                                if v297 then
                                                    Character.Runtime.lastHumanSkillTick = currentTitan

                                                    if Character.Runtime.humanRotIdx > #active then
                                                        Character.Runtime.humanRotIdx = 1
                                                    end

                                                    currentTitan = active[Character.Runtime.humanRotIdx]
                                                    Character.Runtime.humanRotIdx = Character.Runtime.humanRotIdx % #active + 1
                                                    active = Character.Stats.hotbar

                                                    if active then
                                                        active = Character.Stats.hotbar[currentTitan]
                                                    end

                                                    if active then
                                                        v297 = Character.Combat.LOC_SKILLS[active]
                                                    else
                                                        v297 = active
                                                    end

                                                    if v297 then
                                                        nape = nape.Position
                                                    else
                                                        nape = v297
                                                    end

                                                    t1.value7("AutoUseSkills: cast hotbar slot", currentTitan, "id", active or "?")
                                                    Character.Combat.fireSkill(currentTitan, nape or nil, v297 == "tbl")
                                                end
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end

                                    continue
                                end
                            end
                        else
                            if v297 then
                                if active then
                                    active = currentTitan < active
                                end
                            else
                                active = v297
                            end

                            if active and (not Character.Runtime.safetyNotifyTick or tick() - Character.Runtime.safetyNotifyTick >= 10) then
                                Character.Runtime.safetyNotifyTick = tick()
                                t1.value7("Safety Timer: Seconds frozen at", currentTitan, "-> attacking to un-stick")
                            end
                        end

                        currentTitan = t1.value3:GetAttribute("Shifting")
                        nape = t1.value3
                        currentTitan = currentTitan == true

                        if nape:GetAttribute("Weapon") == "Spears" then
                            nape = false
                        else
                            nape = not currentTitan
                        end

                        if nape then
                            nape = Character.Char.getBlade1()

                            if nape then
                                nape = nape.Transparency == 1
                            end

                            if nape then
                                continue
                            end
                        end

                        Character.Combat.attack()

                        if Character.Config.AutoUseSkills then
                            nape = Character.Combat.hasTarget(500)

                            if not currentTitan and nape then
                                currentTitan = tick()

                                if currentTitan - Character.Runtime.lastHumanSkillTick > 0.6 then
                                    active = Character.Combat.humanSkillSlots()

                                    if active then
                                        v297 = #active > 0
                                    else
                                        v297 = active
                                    end

                                    if v297 then
                                        Character.Runtime.lastHumanSkillTick = currentTitan

                                        if Character.Runtime.humanRotIdx > #active then
                                            Character.Runtime.humanRotIdx = 1
                                        end

                                        currentTitan = active[Character.Runtime.humanRotIdx]
                                        Character.Runtime.humanRotIdx = Character.Runtime.humanRotIdx % #active + 1
                                        active = Character.Stats.hotbar

                                        if active then
                                            active = Character.Stats.hotbar[currentTitan]
                                        end

                                        if active then
                                            v297 = Character.Combat.LOC_SKILLS[active]
                                        else
                                            v297 = active
                                        end

                                        if v297 then
                                            nape = nape.Position
                                        else
                                            nape = v297
                                        end

                                        t1.value7("AutoUseSkills: cast hotbar slot", currentTitan, "id", active or "?")
                                        Character.Combat.fireSkill(currentTitan, nape or nil, v297 == "tbl")
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        continue
                    end
                end
            end)
            Character.Tasks.movement = Character.Task.new("Movement", function(p83)
                while p83.enabled do
                    task.wait(0.1)

                    if not p83.enabled then
                        Character.Move.cancel()

                        return
                    end

                    local value = select(2, Character.Char.get())

                    if value then
                        Character.Target.update()

                        if not Character.Runtime.objectiveMode then
                            local AutoTitanMastery = Character.Config.AutoTitanMastery

                            if AutoTitanMastery then
                                AutoTitanMastery = t1.value3:GetAttribute("Shifting") == true
                            end

                            local currentTitan

                            if AutoTitanMastery then
                                AutoTitanMastery = Character.Runtime.nape
                                currentTitan = Character.Runtime.currentTitan

                                local Parent

                                if AutoTitanMastery then
                                    Parent = AutoTitanMastery.Parent
                                else
                                    Parent = AutoTitanMastery
                                end

                                if Parent then
                                    Parent = 40

                                    if currentTitan then
                                        currentTitan = currentTitan.PrimaryPart or (currentTitan:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or currentTitan:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
                                    end

                                    local LookVector

                                    if currentTitan then
                                        LookVector = currentTitan.CFrame.LookVector
                                        currentTitan = currentTitan.Position - LookVector * Parent
                                        AutoTitanMastery = Vector3.new(currentTitan.X, AutoTitanMastery.Position.Y, currentTitan.Z)
                                        Character.Move.to(value, AutoTitanMastery, LookVector)
                                    else
                                        currentTitan = value.Position - AutoTitanMastery.Position
                                        LookVector = currentTitan.Magnitude
                                        AutoTitanMastery = AutoTitanMastery.Position + (LookVector > 0.1 and currentTitan / LookVector or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1) * Parent)
                                        Character.Move.to(value, AutoTitanMastery, -(currentTitan.Magnitude > 0.1) and currentTitan / LookVector or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1))
                                    end
                                else
                                    Character.Move.cancel()
                                end
                            else
                                AutoTitanMastery, currentTitan = Character.Target.movingObjective()

                                if AutoTitanMastery and currentTitan then
                                    Character.Move.to(value, AutoTitanMastery + Vector3.new(0, Character.Config.HoverHeight, 0))
                                else
                                    AutoTitanMastery = Character.Target.raidBossNape()
                                    Character.Runtime.bossHover = AutoTitanMastery ~= nil

                                    if AutoTitanMastery then
                                        AutoTitanMastery = AutoTitanMastery.Position + Vector3.new(0, Character.Config.HoverHeight, 0)
                                        Character.Move.to(value, Character.Combat.chaseHold(AutoTitanMastery, 1000, Character.Config.HoverHeight))
                                    else
                                        AutoTitanMastery = Character.Runtime.nape
                                        currentTitan = Character.Runtime.currentTitan

                                        if AutoTitanMastery and currentTitan and (currentTitan:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") and currentTitan.Parent) then
                                            Character.Move.to(value, AutoTitanMastery.Position + Vector3.new(0, Character.Config.HoverHeight, 0))
                                        else
                                            Character.Move.cancel()

                                            if currentTitan then
                                                currentTitan = currentTitan.Parent
                                            end

                                            if not currentTitan then
                                                value = Character.Runtime
                                                AutoTitanMastery = Character.Runtime
                                                value.currentTitan = nil
                                                AutoTitanMastery.nape = nil
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                Character.Move.cancel()
            end)
            Character.Tasks.titanMastery = Character.Task.new("TitanMastery", function(p84)
                while true do
                    if not p84.enabled then
                        return
                    end

                    task.wait(0.3)

                    if not p84.enabled then
                        return
                    end

                    if Character.Runtime.farming and (Character.Config.AutoTitanMastery and isfolder_()) and not (workspace:GetAttribute("Rewarded") or workspace:GetAttribute("Force_End")) then
                        local titanShifted = t1.value3:GetAttribute("Shifting") == true
                        local attribute = t1.value3:GetAttribute("Bar") or 0
                        local attribute2 = t1.value3:GetAttribute("Max_Bar") or 100
                        local now = tick()

                        if titanShifted ~= Character.Runtime.titanShifted then
                            Character.Runtime.titanShifted = titanShifted

                            if titanShifted then
                                Character.Runtime.skillRotIdx = 1
                                Character.Runtime.shiftAnimUntil = now + 2.5
                                Character.Features.startNoclip()
                                t1.value7("TitanMastery: shifted into titan actor refreshed, waiting for shift animation")
                            else
                                t1.value7("TitanMastery: back to human actor refreshed, charging bar")
                            end
                        end

                        if titanShifted then
                            if now >= Character.Runtime.shiftAnimUntil and (Character.Combat.hasTarget(500) and now - Character.Runtime.lastSkillTick > 0.6) then
                                Character.Runtime.lastSkillTick = now
                                titanShifted = Character.Runtime.skillRotIdx

                                for i = 1, 5 do
                                    if not Character.Runtime.ejectSlots[titanShifted] then
                                        break
                                    end

                                    titanShifted = titanShifted % 5 + 1
                                end

                                if Character.Runtime.tossSlots[titanShifted] then
                                    attribute = select(2, Character.Char.get())
                                    attribute = not (attribute and attribute.Position + attribute.CFrame.LookVector * 80) and Character.Runtime.nape

                                    if attribute then
                                        attribute = Character.Runtime.nape.Position
                                    end

                                    t1.value7("TitanMastery: Titan Toss slot", titanShifted, "\226\128\148 grab")
                                    Character.Combat.fireSkill(titanShifted, attribute)

                                    for i = 1, 4 do
                                        task.wait(0.5)

                                        if t1.value3:GetAttribute("Target") == nil then
                                            break
                                        end

                                        Character.Combat.fireSkill(titanShifted, attribute)
                                        t1.value7("TitanMastery: Titan Toss \226\128\148 throw attempt")
                                    end
                                elseif not Character.Runtime.ejectSlots[titanShifted] then
                                    t1.value7("TitanMastery: skill Usage slot", titanShifted, "bar=" .. string.format("%.0f", attribute) .. "/" .. tostring(attribute2))
                                    Character.Combat.fireSkill(titanShifted)
                                end

                                Character.Runtime.skillRotIdx = titanShifted % 5 + 1
                            end
                        else
                            if attribute2 <= attribute then
                                titanShifted = now - Character.Runtime.lastShiftTick > 2
                            else
                                titanShifted = false
                            end

                            if titanShifted then
                                Character.Runtime.lastShiftTick = now
                                titanShifted = Character.Combat.shiftSlot()

                                if titanShifted then
                                    t1.value7("TitanMastery: bar full (" .. string.format("%.0f", attribute) .. "/" .. tostring(attribute2) .. ") \226\128\148 firing shift on hotbar slot", titanShifted)
                                    Character.Combat.fireSkill(titanShifted)
                                else
                                    t1.value7("TitanMastery: bar full but shift slot (\'999\') not resolved \226\128\148 retrying")
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end)
            Character.Features = {}

            function Character.Features.startNoclip()
                local Character2 = t1.value3.Character

                if not Character2 then
                    return
                end
            end
            function Character.Features.initEscape()
                Character.Cache.buttonsFolder = Character.Util.safeIndex(t1.value4, "Interface", "Buttons")
            end
            function Character.Features.setupEscape()
                if Character.Cache.buttonsFolder then
                    if not Character.Cache.buttonsFolder then
                        return
                    end

                    return
                end

                Character.Features.initEscape()

                if not Character.Cache.buttonsFolder then
                    return
                end
            end
            function Character.Features.clearESP()
                Character.Connection.disconnect("ESP")
                Character.Connection.disconnect("ESPRemoved")

                if not Character.Cache.espFolder then
                    Character.Cache.espFolder = nil
                    Character.Cache.espHighlights = {}

                    return
                end

                local function v318()
                    Character.Cache.espFolder:Destroy()
                end

                pcall(v318)
                Character.Cache.espFolder = nil
                Character.Cache.espHighlights = {}
            end
            function Character.Features.updateESP()
                Character.Features.clearESP()

                local Titans = workspace:FindFirstChild("Titans")

                if not Titans then
                    return
                end
            end
            function Character.Features.skipCutscene(p85)
                if not (p85 and p85.Parent) then
                    return
                end
            end
            function Character.Features.startCutsceneMonitor()
                local v320 = Character.Util.safeIndex(workspace, "Unclimbable", "Cutscene")

                if not v320 then
                    return
                end
            end
            function Character.Features.stopCutsceneMonitor()
                Character.Connection.disconnect("Cutscene")
            end
            function Character.Features.skipActive()
                local v321 = Character.Util.safeIndex(workspace, "Unclimbable", "Cutscene")

                if v321 then
                    local GetChildren = v321.GetChildren

                    for _, v in ipairs(GetChildren(v321)) do
                        Character.Features.skipCutscene(v)
                    end

                    return
                else
                    return
                end
            end
            function Character.Features.cutsceneActive()
                local v325 = Character.Util.safeIndex(workspace, "Unclimbable", "Cutscene")

                if v325 == nil then
                    v325 = false
                else
                    v325 = #v325:GetChildren() > 0
                end

                return v325
            end

            Character.SoloOnly = {}

            function Character.SoloOnly.Setup()
                Character.Connection.disconnect("SoloOnly")

                if Character.Config.SoloOnly then
                    if not (Character.Runtime.farming and isfolder_()) then
                        return
                    end

                    return
                else
                    return
                end
            end

            Character.Farm = {}

            function Character.Farm.leaveToLobby(p86)
                local v326 = tick() + (p86 or 30)

                while true do
                    local v327 = isfolder_()

                    if v327 then
                        v327 = tick() < v326
                    end

                    if not v327 then
                        return not isfolder_()
                    end

                    Character.Actor.send("Functions", "Teleport")
                    task.wait(2)
                end
            end
            function Character.Farm.start()
                if Character.Runtime.farming then
                    return
                end

                Character.Runtime.farming = true
                Character.Stats.FarmStartTime = tick()
                Character.Features.initEscape()
                task.spawn(function()
                    if Character.Cache.refill then
                        Character.Char.initBladeRefs()

                        return
                    end

                    Character.Cache.refill = Character.Combat.findRefill()
                    Character.Char.initBladeRefs()
                end)
                task.spawn(function()
                    task.wait(Character.Config.WaitBeforeFarm)

                    if not Character.Runtime.farming then
                        return
                    end

                    local v328 = tick() + 30
                    local PlayerGui

                    while tick() < v328 do
                        PlayerGui = t1.value3:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")

                        if PlayerGui then
                            PlayerGui = t1.value3.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("Cache") and t1.value3.PlayerGui.Cache:FindFirstChild("Fullscreen_Interface")

                            if PlayerGui then
                                PlayerGui = t1.value3.PlayerGui.Cache.Fullscreen_Interface:FindFirstChild("Loading_Screen")
                            end
                        end

                        if not (PlayerGui and PlayerGui.Visible) then
                            break
                        end

                        t1.value7("Farm.start: waiting for loading screen to disappear...")
                        task.wait(1)
                    end

                    if not Character.Runtime.farming then
                        return
                    end

                    v328 = tick() + 15

                    while tick() < v328 do
                        PlayerGui = t1.value3.Character

                        if PlayerGui then
                            PlayerGui = PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                        end

                        if PlayerGui then
                            break
                        end

                        task.wait(0.5)
                    end

                    if not Character.Runtime.farming then
                        return
                    end

                    Character.Char.setAnchor(true)
                    Character.Features.startNoclip()

                    if not Character.Conn.Escape then
                        Character.Features.setupEscape()
                    end

                    v328 = Character.Config.NapeExtender

                    if v328 then
                        v328 = not Character.Conn.NapeMonitor
                    end

                    if v328 then
                        Character.Nape.startMonitor()
                    end

                    Character.Tasks.attack:start()
                    Character.Tasks.movement:start()

                    if Character.Config.AutoDie then
                        Character.Tasks.streakWatch:start()
                    end

                    if Character.Config.AutoTitanMastery then
                        Character.Runtime.titanShifted = false
                        Character.Tasks.titanMastery:start()
                        t1.value7("TitanMastery: task started with farm")
                    end

                    v328 = Character.Config.SoloOnly

                    if v328 then
                        v328 = Character.Runtime.farming
                    end

                    if not v328 then
                        return
                    end

                    Character.SoloOnly.Setup()
                end)

                if not Character.Config.TitanESP then
                    Character.Features.startCutsceneMonitor()
                    Character.Features.skipActive()
                    Character.Colossal.startMonitor()
                    Character.Tasks.waveMonitor:start()
                    readfile_("Auto Farm", "Started!", 2, "play")

                    return
                end

                Character.Features.updateESP()
                Character.Features.startCutsceneMonitor()
                Character.Features.skipActive()
                Character.Colossal.startMonitor()
                Character.Tasks.waveMonitor:start()
                readfile_("Auto Farm", "Started!", 2, "play")
            end
            function Character.Farm.stop()
                Character.Runtime.farming = false
                Character.Runtime.bossHover = false
                Character.Runtime.attackBlockedTick = 0
                Character.Runtime.fullReloadCooldownTick = 0
                Character.Runtime.isReloading = false
                Character.Move.cancel()
                Character.Tasks.attack:stop()
                Character.Tasks.movement:stop()
                Character.Tasks.streakWatch:stop()
                Character.Tasks.titanMastery:stop()
                Character.Runtime.titanShifted = false
                Character.Runtime.shiftSlot = nil
                Character.Runtime.humanSkillSlots = nil
                Character.Connection.disconnect("NoclipNewParts")
                Character.Connection.disconnect("NoclipWatch")
                Character.Connection.disconnect("SoloOnly")
                Character.Char.setAnchor(false)

                if Character.Config.TitanESP then
                    Character.Features.stopCutsceneMonitor()
                    Character.Colossal.stopMonitor()
                    Character.Tasks.waveMonitor:stop()
                    v423 = Character.Runtime
                    v424 = Character.Runtime
                    v423.currentTitan = nil
                    v424.nape = nil

                    return
                end

                Character.Features.clearESP()
                Character.Features.stopCutsceneMonitor()
                Character.Colossal.stopMonitor()
                Character.Tasks.waveMonitor:stop()

                local Runtime = Character.Runtime
                local Runtime2 = Character.Runtime

                Runtime.currentTitan = nil
                Runtime2.nape = nil
            end

            Character.DataCopy = {}
            Character.DataCopy.TTL = 30
            Character.DataCopy.fetching = false
            Character.DIFFICULTY_POTENTIAL = {
				{ "Easy", 0 },
				{ "Normal", 2 },
				{ "Hard", 5 },
				{ "Severe", 9 },
				{ "Aberrant", 12 }
			}

            function Character.DataCopy.highestDifficulty(p87)
                local s1 = "Easy"

                for _, v in ipairs(Character.DIFFICULTY_POTENTIAL) do
                    if v[2] <= p87 then
                        s1 = v[1]
                    end
                end

                return s1
            end

            Character.DataCopy.MAP_EXPR = [[            if type(res) ~= "table" then out = nil; return end
            local slot = res.Current_Slot
            local s    = slot and res.Slots and res.Slots[slot]
            local prog = s and s.Progression or {}
            local st   = res.Statistics and res.Statistics.Streak
            local tk   = res.Statistics and res.Statistics.Titan_Kills
            local dis  = res.Disabled
            -- weapon / upgrades / potential
            local weapon = tostring(s and s.Weapon or "Blades")
            local upgrades = (s and s.Upgrades and s.Upgrades[weapon]) or {}
            local total, count = 0, 0
            for _, lv in pairs(upgrades) do total = total + (tonumber(lv) or 0); count = count + 1 end
            local potential = count > 0 and math.floor(total / count) or 0
            local upMap = {}
            for stat, lv in pairs(upgrades) do upMap[tostring(stat)] = lv end
            -- skill loadout
            local sk = s and s.Skills
            local hb, sh = sk and sk.Hotbar, sk and sk.Shifter
            -- human hotbar slots 1-5
            local hotbar = {}
            if type(hb) == "table" then
                for i = 1, 5 do hotbar[i] = tostring(hb[i] or "") end
            end
            -- titan skill loadout: shift slot + eject/toss (Shifter)
            local shift, eject, toss = nil, {}, {}
            if type(hb) == "table" then
                for i = 1, 5 do if tostring(hb[i]) == "999" then shift = i; break end end
            end
            if type(sh) == "table" then
                for i = 1, 5 do
                    local id = tostring(sh[i])
                    if id == "200" or id == "300" or id == "400" or id == "500" then eject[tostring(i)] = true end
                    if id == "301" then toss[tostring(i)] = true end
                end
            end
            -- unlocked skill IDs (set keyed by id string, value true)
            local unlockedSkills = {}
            local skillsUnlocked = sk and sk.Unlocked
            if type(skillsUnlocked) == "table" then
                for _, id in pairs(skillsUnlocked) do
                    unlockedSkills[tostring(id)] = true
                end
            end
            -- unequipped perk storage (rarity resolved after invoke, outside loadstring env)
            local perkStorage = {}
            local perksData = s and s.Perks
            if perksData then
                local equipped = {}
                if type(perksData.Equipped) == "table" then
                    for _, uuid in pairs(perksData.Equipped) do
                        if type(uuid) == "string" and uuid ~= "" then equipped[uuid] = true end
                    end
                end
                if type(perksData.Storage) == "table" then
                    for id, info in pairs(perksData.Storage) do
                        if type(info) == "table" and not equipped[tostring(id)] then
                            perkStorage[#perkStorage+1] = {
                                id   = tostring(id),
                                name = tostring(info.Name or ""),
                            }
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            out = {
                slot     = tostring(slot or ""),
                level    = tonumber(prog.Level)    or 0,
                prestige = tonumber(prog.Prestige) or 0,
                streak   = tonumber(st and st.Total) or 0,
                titanKills = tonumber(tk and tk.Total) or 0,
                disabled = (type(dis) == "string" and dis ~= "") and dis or false,
                weapon = weapon, upgrades = upMap, potential = potential, hotbar = hotbar,
                shiftSlot = shift, ejectSlots = eject, tossSlots = toss,
                perkStorage = perkStorage,
                unlockedSkills = unlockedSkills,
            }
]]

            function Character.DataCopy.fetch(p88)
                if Character.DataCopy.fetching then
                    return false
                end

                local v335 = not p88

                if v335 then
                    v335 = tick() - (Character.Stats.dataCopyStamp or 0) < Character.DataCopy.TTL
                end

                if v335 then
                    return false
                end

                Character.DataCopy.fetching = true
                v335 = Character.Actor.invokeGET({
					"Functions",
					"Settings",
					"Blur",
					"Off"
				}, Character.DataCopy.MAP_EXPR)
                Character.DataCopy.fetching = false

                local v336 = not (v335 and v335.ok)

                if v336 then
                    if v336 then
                        t1.value7("DataCopy.fetch: failed", v335 and v335.err or "nil")

                        return false
                    else
                        v335 = v335.data

                        return Character.DataCopy._apply(v335)
                    end

                    return
                end

                v336 = v335.data
                v336 = type(v336) ~= "table"

                if v336 then
                    t1.value7("DataCopy.fetch: failed", v335 and v335.err or "nil")

                    return false
                else
                    v335 = v335.data

                    return Character.DataCopy._apply(v335)
                end
            end
            function Character.DataCopy._apply(p89)
                Character.Stats.dataCopyStamp = tick()
                Character.Stats.statsStamp = tick()

                if p89.weapon then
                    Character.Stats.weapon = p89.weapon
                end

                local weapon = p89.weapon

                if weapon then
                    weapon = p89.upgrades
                    weapon = type(weapon) == "table"
                end

                if weapon then
                    Character.Stats.upgrades[p89.weapon] = p89.upgrades
                end

                Character.Stats.potential = p89.potential or 0
                weapon = p89.hotbar

                if type(weapon) == "table" then
                    v452 = {}
                    v453 = {}

                    for i = 1, 5 do
                        v454 = p89.hotbar[i] or ""
                        v454 = tostring(v454)
                        v452[i] = v454

                        if v454 == "" or v454 == "999" then
                            v454 = false
                        else
                            v454 = v454 ~= "nil"
                        end

                        if v454 then
                            v453[#v453 + 1] = i
                        end
                    end

                    Character.Stats.hotbar = v452
                    Character.Runtime.humanSkillSlots = v453
                end

                Character.Runtime.shiftSlot = p89.shiftSlot
                Character.Runtime.ejectSlots = {}
                Character.Runtime.tossSlots = {}

                if type(p89.ejectSlots) == "table" then
                    for k in pairs(p89.ejectSlots) do
                        Character.Runtime.ejectSlots[tonumber(k)] = true
                    end
                end

                if type(p89.tossSlots) == "table" then
                    for k in pairs(p89.tossSlots) do
                        Character.Runtime.tossSlots[tonumber(k)] = true
                    end
                end

                weapon = p89.disabled
                Character.Stats.shadowBan = weapon and true or false

                local Stats = Character.Stats

                if weapon then
                    weapon = tostring(weapon)
                end

                Stats.disabledReason = weapon or nil
                Character.Stats.streak = p89.streak
                Character.Stats.titanKills = p89.titanKills or (Character.Stats.titanKills or 0)
                weapon = p89.unlockedSkills

                if type(weapon) == "table" then
                    Character.Stats.unlockedSkills = p89.unlockedSkills
                    t1.value7("DataCopy: unlockedSkills=" .. Character.Util.count(p89.unlockedSkills))
                end

                weapon = p89.perkStorage

                if type(weapon) == "table" then
                    weapon = #p89.perkStorage > 0
                else
                    weapon = false
                end

                if weapon then
                    local v342
                    weapon = function()
                        local Perks = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.Storage.Perks)
                        local v344

                        if type(Perks) == "table" then
                            v444 = 0

                            for k, Perk in pairs(Perks) do
                                if type(Perk) == "table" then
                                    v344 = type(k) == "string"
                                else
                                    v344 = false
                                end

                                if v344 then
                                    for k2 in pairs(Perk) do
                                        if type(k2) == "string" then
                                            v342[k2] = k
                                            v444 = v444 + 1
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            t1.value7("DataCopy: perkRarityOf built,", v444, "entries")

                            return
                        end

                        error("PM not a table: " .. type(Perks))

                        local n4 = 0

                        for k, Perk in pairs(Perks) do
                            if type(Perk) == "table" then
                                v344 = type(k) == "string"
                            else
                                v344 = false
                            end

                            if v344 then
                                for k2 in pairs(Perk) do
                                    if type(k2) == "string" then
                                        v342[k2] = k
                                        n4 = n4 + 1
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end

                        t1.value7("DataCopy: perkRarityOf built,", n4, "entries")
                    end
                    v342 = {}
                    weapon = { pcall(weapon) }
                    Stats = weapon[2]
                    if not weapon[1] then
                        t1.value7("DataCopy: require Perks failed:", Stats)
                    end
                    local v352 = v342
                    for _, v in ipairs(p89.perkStorage) do
                        v.rarity = v352[v.name] or "Unknown"
                    end
                    Character.Stats.perkStorage = p89.perkStorage
                    t1.value7("DataCopy: resolved rarity for", #p89.perkStorage, "storage perks")
                end

                if p89.slot == "" then
                    weapon = t1.value7
                    Stats = string.format
                    v451 = p89.slot
                    v452 = p89.level
                    v453 = p89.prestige
                    v454 = p89.streak
                    v455 = p89.disabled
                    weapon(Stats("DataCopy.fetch: slot=%s lvl=%d prestige=%d streak=%d banned=%s", v451, v452, v453, v454, (tostring(v455))))
                    task.defer(Character.DB.save)

                    return true
                end

                Character.Stats.currentSlot = p89.slot

                if p89.prestige < Character.Prestige.MAX_TIER then
                    weapon = p89.level >= Character.Prestige.maxLevelFor(p89.prestige)
                else
                    weapon = false
                end

                Character.Stats.prestigeSnapshot[p89.slot] = {
					["level"] = p89.level,
					["prestige"] = p89.prestige,
					["ready"] = weapon
				}
                Character.Stats.prestigeStamp = tick()
                weapon = t1.value7
                Stats = string.format

                local slot = p89.slot
                local level = p89.level
                local prestige = p89.prestige
                local streak = p89.streak
                local disabled = p89.disabled

                weapon(Stats("DataCopy.fetch: slot=%s lvl=%d prestige=%d streak=%d banned=%s", slot, level, prestige, streak, (tostring(disabled))))
                task.defer(Character.DB.save)

                return true
            end

            Character.Prestige = Character.Prestige or {}
            Character.Prestige.MAX_TIER = 5

            function Character.Prestige.maxLevelFor(p90)
                return 100 + (tonumber(p90) or 0) * 25
            end
            function Character.Prestige.fetch(p91)
                Character.DataCopy.fetch(p91)
            end
            function Character.Prestige.snapshot()
                local currentSlot = Character.Stats.currentSlot

                if not currentSlot then
                    return currentSlot or nil
                end

                currentSlot = Character.Stats.prestigeSnapshot[currentSlot]

                return currentSlot or nil
            end

            Character.Prestige.BOOST_TAG = {
				["Luck"] = "Luck Boost",
				["EXP"] = "EXP Boost",
				["Gold"] = "Gold Boost"
			}

            function Character.Prestige.readGold()
                local v361 = tick() + 5
                local v362 = v361 < tick()

                while true do
                    v362 = Character.Util.safeIndex(t1.value4, "Interface", "Topbar", "Main", "Currencies", "Gold", "Amount")

                    if not v362 then
                        task.wait(0.5)
                    end

                    if v362 or v361 < tick() then
                        if v362 then
                            v361 = v362.Text
                            v361 = tostring(v361)
                            v362 = v361:gsub("[%s,]", "")
                            v362 = tonumber(v362)
                            t1.value7("readGold: raw=" .. v361 .. " result=" .. tostring(v362))

                            return v362
                        else
                            t1.value7("readGold: label not found after 5s")

                            return nil
                        end

                        return
                    end
                end
            end
            function Character.Prestige.runOnce()
                local v363 = Character.Prestige.snapshot()

                if not v363 then
                    return false, "no snapshot (enter a game first)"
                end

                if not v363.ready then
                    return false, "not eligible (Lvl/Prestige)"
                end

                local v364 = (v363.prestige or 0) + 1

                if v364 > 5 then
                    return false, "max prestige"
                end

                local v365 = Character.Config.PrestigeGold[v364] or 0

                if v365 > 0 then
                    v464 = Character.Prestige.readGold()

                    if not v464 then
                        return false, "gold unreadable"
                    end

                    if v464 < v365 then
                        return false, string.format("gold %d/%d", v464, v365)
                    end
                end

                v365 = Character.Actor.invokeMulti("S_Equipment", "Talents", "nil", [[        local ids = b
        if type(ids) ~= "table" then out = nil; return end
        local Mem = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Modules.Storage.Memories)
        local root = Mem.Talents or Mem
