        local RANK = { Common = 1, Uncommon = 2, Rare = 3, Epic = 4 }
        local bestTag, bestRank
        for _, id in ipairs(ids) do
            for tier, bucket in pairs(root) do
                local e = type(bucket) == "table" and bucket[tostring(id)]
                if e and e.Tag then
                    local r = RANK[tier] or 0
                    if not bestRank or r > bestRank then bestTag, bestRank = e.Tag, r end
                end
            end
        end
        out = bestTag and { tag = bestTag } or nil
    ]], 8)

                local v366 = not v365

                if not v366 then
                    v366 = not v365.ok

                    if not v366 then
                        v366 = v365.data
                        v366 = type(v366) ~= "table" and true or not v365.data.tag
                    end
                end

                if v366 then
                    return false, "Talents roll failed"
                end

                v365 = v365.data.tag
                v366 = Character.Prestige.BOOST_TAG[Character.Config.PrestigeBoost[v364] or "Gold"] or "Gold Boost"

                local t14 = {
					["argsExpr"] = string.format("{ Boosts = %q, Talents = %q }", v366, v365),
					["mapExpr"] = "out = (res ~= nil)",
					["timeout"] = 10
				}

                t14 = Character.Actor.invoke("S_Equipment", "Prestige", t14)

                if not (t14 and t14.ok) then
                    return false, "Prestige invoke failed"
                end

                t14 = Character.Stats.currentSlot

                if t14 then
                    v466 = Character.Stats.prestigeSnapshot[t14]
                else
                    v466 = t14
                end

                if not v466 then
                    t1.value7(string.format("Prestige.runOnce: P%d->%d boost=%s memory=%s", v363.prestige, v364, v366, v365))

                    return true, string.format("P%d -> %d (%s, %s)", v363.prestige, v364, v366, v365)
                end

                local ready = Character
                local prestige = v363.prestige + 1

                ready.Stats.prestigeSnapshot[t14].prestige = prestige
                t14 = Character.Stats.prestigeSnapshot[t14]

                if prestige < Character.Prestige.MAX_TIER then
                    ready = v363.level >= Character.Prestige.maxLevelFor(prestige)
                else
                    ready = false
                end

                t14.ready = ready
                t1.value7(string.format("Prestige.runOnce: P%d->%d boost=%s memory=%s", v363.prestige, v364, v366, v365))

                return true, string.format("P%d -> %d (%s, %s)", v363.prestige, v364, v366, v365)
            end

            end)

            function Character.DB.checkShadowBan()
                if Character.LOBBY_PLACE_IDS[game.PlaceId] then
                    Character.DataCopy.fetch()

                    local attribute = t1.value3:GetAttribute("Blacklisted")
                    local attribute2 = t1.value3:GetAttribute("Exploiter")

                    if (attribute == true or attribute2 == true) and true or Character.Stats.shadowBan == true then
                        return "SHADOW_BANNED", Character.Stats.disabledReason or (attribute == true and true or (attribute2 == true and "Blacklisted/Exploiter" or "Disabled"))
                    else
                        return "SAFE", nil
                    end

                    return
                else
                    if (Character.Stats.dataCopyStamp or 0) > 0 then
                        if Character.Stats.shadowBan then
                            return "SHADOW_BANNED", Character.Stats.disabledReason or "Disabled field set"
                        else
                            return "SAFE", nil
                        end

                        return
                    else
                        if Character.Stats.shadowBan == nil then
                            return "UNKNOWN", nil
                        else
                            return Character.Stats.shadowBan and "SHADOW_BANNED" or "SAFE", Character.Stats.disabledReason
                        end

                        return
                    end

                    return
                end
            end

            Character.Mission.ALL_OBJECTIVES = (function()

            function Character.Mission.objectivesFor(p94)
                for _, map in ipairs(Character.Mission.MAPS) do
                    if map.name == p94 then
                        return map.objectives
                    end
                end

                return { "Skirmish" }
            end
            function Character.Mission.asStr(p95)
                if type(p95) ~= "table" then
                    if type(p95) == "string" then
                        v485 = p95
                    else
                        v485 = false
                    end

                    return v485 or tostring(p95 or "")
                end

                local v383 = p95[1]

                if type(v383) == "string" then
                    p95 = p95[1]
                else
                    for k, v in pairs(p95) do
                        local v386

                        if v386 == true then
                            v386 = type(k) == "string"
                        else
                            v386 = false
                        end

                        if v386 then
                            p95 = k

                            break
                        end
                    end
                end

                if type(p95) == "string" then
                    v383 = p95
                else
                    v383 = false
                end

                return v383 or tostring(p95 or "")
            end

            function Character.Mission.create()
                local asStr = Character.Mission.asStr

                asStr = {
					["argsExpr"] = string.format("{ Name = %q, Difficulty = %q, Type = \"Missions\", Objective = %q, Minimum = nil }", asStr(Character.Lobby.missionMap), asStr(Character.Lobby.missionDifficulty), asStr(Character.Lobby.missionObjective)),
					["mapExpr"] = "        if typeof(res) == \"Instance\" and res.Name then\n            out = { ok = true, name = res.Name, mtype = res:GetAttribute(\"Type\") }\n        else\n            out = { ok = false, retType = typeof(res), retVal = tostring(res) }\n        end\n    ",
					["timeout"] = 8
				}
                asStr = Character.Actor.invoke("S_Missions", "Create", asStr)

                if not asStr then
                    t1.value7("Mission.create: nil (timeout/no actor)")

                    return nil
                end

                local data = asStr.data

                if not (not asStr.ok or (type(data) ~= "table" and true or not data.ok)) then
                    asStr = t1.value7
                    v492 = data.name
                    v492 = tostring(v492)
                    v493 = data.mtype
                    asStr("Mission.create: OK name=" .. v492 .. " type=" .. tostring(v493))

                    return {
						["ok"] = true,
						["name"] = data.name,
						["mtype"] = data.mtype
					}
                end

                local value7 = t1.value7
                local s2 = "Mission.create: rejected \226\128\148 serverReturn type="
                local tostring_ = tostring

                if data then
                    v495 = data.retType
                else
                    v495 = data
                end

                tostring_ = tostring_(v495)

                local s3 = " val="
                local tostring_2 = tostring

                if not data then
                    data = tostring_2(data)
                    asStr = asStr.err
                    value7(s2 .. tostring_ .. s3 .. data .. " err=" .. tostring(asStr))

                    return {
						["ok"] = false
					}
                end

                data = data.retVal
                data = tostring_2(data)
                asStr = asStr.err
                value7(s2 .. tostring_ .. s3 .. data .. " err=" .. tostring(asStr))

                return {
					["ok"] = false
				}
            end
            function Character.Mission.start()
                local S_Missions = Character.Actor.invoke("S_Missions", "Start", {
					["timeout"] = 8
				})

                if S_Missions == nil then
                    S_Missions = false
                else
                    S_Missions = S_Missions.ok == true
                end

                return S_Missions
            end
            function Character.Mission.toggleModifier(p97)
                Character.Actor.invoke("S_Missions", "Modify", {
					["argsExpr"] = string.format("%q", p97),
					["mapExpr"] = "out = true",
					["timeout"] = 5
				})
            end
            function Character.Mission.leave()
                local S_Missions = Character.Actor.invoke("S_Missions", "Leave", {
					["mapExpr"] = "out = (res == true)",
					["timeout"] = 5
				})

                if S_Missions == nil or S_Missions.ok ~= true then
                    S_Missions = false
                else
                    S_Missions = S_Missions.data == true
                end

                return S_Missions
            end

            color34 = function(p98, p99, p100, p101, p102)
                p99("Creating session...")

                local v396 = p100()

                if v396 == nil then
                    p99("Timeout.")

                    return false, "timeout"
                else
                    if v396.ok then
                        for _, v in ipairs(p101) do
                            Character.Mission.toggleModifier(v)
                            task.wait(0.3)
                        end

                        p99("Starting session...")
                        task.wait(0.5)

                        if Character.Mission.start() then
                            local v399 = #p101 > 0 and " [" .. table.concat(p101, ", ") .. "]" or ""

                            p99("Started! " .. (v396.name or p102) .. v399)
                            t1.value7(p98 .. " started:", v396.name or p102, v399)

                            return true
                        else
                            p99("Start failed destroying session...")
                            readfile_(p98, "Failed to start, destroying...", 3, "skull")
                            Character.Mission.leave()

                            return false, "start_failed"
                        end

                        return
                    else
                        p99("Failed clearing old session...")
                        t1.value7(p98 .. ".createStartOnce: create failed -> leaving any existing session")
                        Character.Mission.leave()
                        task.wait(0.5)

                        return false, "failed"
                    end

                    return
                end
            end

            function Character.Mission.createStartOnce()

            end

            function Character.Mission.lowerDifficulty(p103)
                local v400
                for i, v in ipairs(Character.Mission.DIFFICULTY_ORDER) do
                    if v == p103 then
                        v400 = i

                        break
                    end
                end
                if not v400 or v400 <= 1 then
                    return nil
                else
                    return Character.Mission.DIFFICULTY_ORDER[v400 - 1]
                end
            end

            Character.Tasks.autoCreate = Character.Task.new("AutoCreate", function(p104)
                local n5 = 0

                while true do
                    if not p104.enabled then
                        color33("Idle.")

                        return
                    end

                    if isfolder_() then
                        color33("Stopped entered game.")

                        return
                    end

                    while true do
                        v519 = p104.enabled and Character.Lobby.anyLobbyBusy()

                        if v519 then
                            v519 = not isfolder_()
                        end

                        if not v519 then
                            break
                        end

                        color33("Waiting: " .. Character.Lobby.busyNames() .. " still running...")
                        task.wait(1)
                    end

                    if not p104.enabled or isfolder_() then
                        color33("Idle.")

                        return
                    end

                    if Character.Lobby.autoCreate.boosted then
                        v519 = workspace:GetAttribute("Boosted_Map")

                        local missionObjective, Lobby

                        v520, missionObjective, Lobby = ipairs(Character.Mission.MAPS)

                        local v406 = false

                        while true do
                            local v407

                            Lobby, v407 = v520(missionObjective, Lobby)

                            if not Lobby then
                                break
                            end

                            if v407.name == v519 then
                                v406 = true

                                break
                            end
                        end

                        if v519 and v406 then
                            v520 = Character.Lobby.missionMap
                            missionObjective = Character.Lobby.missionObjective
                            Character.Lobby.missionMap = v519
                            Lobby = Character.Mission.objectivesFor(v519)

                            if Character.Lobby.missionObjective == "Skirmish" then
                                Character.Lobby.missionObjective = "Skirmish"
                            else
                                Character.Lobby.missionObjective = Lobby[2] or (Lobby[1] or "Skirmish")
                            end

                            color33("Boosted map: " .. v519 .. " (" .. Character.Lobby.missionObjective .. ") creating...")
                            v519, Lobby = Character.Mission.createStartOnce()
                            Lobby = Character.Lobby
                            v406 = Character.Lobby
                            Lobby.missionMap = v520
                            v406.missionObjective = missionObjective

                            if v519 then
                                color33("Idle.")

                                return
                            end

                            n5 = n5 + 1

                            if n5 >= 2 then
                                v519 = not Character.Lobby.questOverride or Character.Lobby.thunderMode
                            else
                                v519 = false
                            end

                            if v519 then
                                v519 = Character.Mission.lowerDifficulty(Character.Lobby.missionDifficulty)

                                if v519 then
                                    Character.Lobby.missionDifficulty = v519
                                    Character.UI.selectDropdown(Character.UI.dropdowns.difficulty, v519)
                                    readfile_("Auto Create", "Repeated fails lowering difficulty to " .. v519, 4, "trending-down")
                                    t1.value7("AutoCreate fallback: difficulty -> " .. v519)
                                    color33("Lowered difficulty to " .. v519 .. " retrying...")
                                    n5 = 0
                                else
                                    color33("Failing at Easy retrying...")
                                end
                            end

                            v519 = task.wait
                            v520 = n5 * 2 - 1
                            v519((math.clamp(v520, 1, 6)))

                            continue
                        else
                            color33("Waiting for any boosted map...")
                            task.wait(5)

                            continue
                        end
                    else
                        v519, v520 = Character.Mission.createStartOnce()
                    end

                    if v519 then
                        color33("Idle.")

                        return
                    end

                    n5 = n5 + 1

                    if n5 >= 2 then
                        v519 = not Character.Lobby.questOverride or Character.Lobby.thunderMode
                    else
                        v519 = false
                    end

                    if v519 then
                        v519 = Character.Mission.lowerDifficulty(Character.Lobby.missionDifficulty)

                        if v519 then
                            Character.Lobby.missionDifficulty = v519
                            Character.UI.selectDropdown(Character.UI.dropdowns.difficulty, v519)
                            readfile_("Auto Create", "Repeated fails lowering difficulty to " .. v519, 4, "trending-down")
                            t1.value7("AutoCreate fallback: difficulty -> " .. v519)
                            color33("Lowered difficulty to " .. v519 .. " retrying...")
                            n5 = 0
                        else
                            color33("Failing at Easy retrying...")
                        end
                    end

                    local wait_ = task.wait
                    local v409 = n5 * 2 - 1

                    wait_((math.clamp(v409, 1, 6)))

                    continue
                end
            end)

            function Character.Raid.create()

                asStr = asStr(Character.Lobby.raidObjective)

                local v412 = Character.Raid.OBJECTIVE_MAP[asStr] or "Trost"

                if asStr == "Colossal Titan" then
                    v525 = data ~= "Aberrant"
                else
                    v525 = false
                end

                asStr = {
					["argsExpr"] = string.format("{ Name = %q, Difficulty = %q, Type = \"Raids\", Objective = %q }", v412, v525 and "Aberrant" or data, asStr),
					["mapExpr"] = "        if typeof(res) == \"Instance\" and res.Name then\n            out = { ok = true, name = res.Name, mtype = res:GetAttribute(\"Type\") }\n        else\n            out = { ok = false, retType = typeof(res), retVal = tostring(res) }\n        end\n    ",
					["timeout"] = 8
				}
                asStr = Character.Actor.invoke("S_Missions", "Create", asStr)

                if not asStr then
                    t1.value7("Raid.create: nil (timeout/no actor)")

                    return nil
                end

                data = asStr.data

                if not (not asStr.ok or (type(data) ~= "table" and true or not data.ok)) then
                    asStr = t1.value7
                    v412 = data.name
                    v412 = tostring(v412)
                    v525 = data.mtype
                    asStr("Raid.create: OK name=" .. v412 .. " type=" .. tostring(v525))

                    return {
						["ok"] = true,
						["name"] = data.name,
						["mtype"] = data.mtype
					}
                end

                asStr = t1.value7
                v412 = "Raid.create: rejected \226\128\148 type="

                local tostring_ = tostring

                if data then
                    v526 = data.retType
                else
                    v526 = data
                end

                tostring_ = tostring_(v526)

                local s4 = " val="
                local tostring_2 = tostring

                if not data then
                    asStr(v412 .. tostring_ .. s4 .. tostring_2(data))

                    return {
						["ok"] = false
					}
                end

                data = data.retVal
                asStr(v412 .. tostring_ .. s4 .. tostring_2(data))

                return {
					["ok"] = false
				}
            end

            Character.Tasks.autoRaid = Character.Task.new("AutoRaid", function(p106)
                local n6 = 0

                while p106.enabled do
                    if isfolder_() then
                        color33("Stopped entered game.")

                        break
                    end

                    while true do
                        v530 = p106.enabled and Character.Lobby.anyLobbyBusy()

                        if v530 then
                            v530 = not isfolder_()
                        end

                        if not v530 then
                            break
                        end

                        task.wait(1)
                    end

                    if not p106.enabled or isfolder_() then
                        color33("Idle.")

                        return
                    end

                    local raidDifficulty = { Character.Raid.createStartOnce() }
                    local v418 = raidDifficulty[2]

                    if raidDifficulty[1] then
                        color33("Idle.")

                        return
                    end

                    n6 = n6 + 1

                    if n6 >= 2 then
                        if Character.Mission.asStr(Character.Lobby.raidObjective) == "Colossal Titan" then
                            color33("Colossal failed retrying...")
                        else
                            raidDifficulty = Character.Mission.lowerDifficulty(Character.Lobby.raidDifficulty)

                            if raidDifficulty then
                                v418 = table.find(Character.Raid.DIFFICULTIES, raidDifficulty)
                            else
                                v418 = raidDifficulty
                            end

                            if v418 then
                                Character.Lobby.raidDifficulty = raidDifficulty
                                Character.UI.selectDropdown(Character.UI.dropdowns.raidDifficulty, raidDifficulty)
                                readfile_("Auto Raid", "Repeated fails lowering difficulty to " .. raidDifficulty, 4, "trending-down")
                                color33("Lowered difficulty to " .. raidDifficulty .. " retrying...")
                                n6 = 0
                            else
                                color33("Failing at Hard retrying...")
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    raidDifficulty = task.wait
                    v418 = n6 * 2 - 1
                    raidDifficulty((math.clamp(v418, 1, 6)))
                end

                color33("Idle.")
            end)

            function Character.Wave.upgradeGear()
                local Remotes = t1.value1.RS:FindFirstChild("Assets") and t1.value1.RS.Assets:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
                local attribute, v421

                if not Remotes then
                    if Remotes then
                        attribute = t1.value1.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Weapon") or Character.Lobby.autoUpgrade.weapon
                        t1.value7("Wave.upgradeGear: activeWeapon=" .. tostring(attribute))
                        v421 = Character.Gear.CATEGORIES[attribute]

                        if not v421 then
                            t1.value7("Wave.upgradeGear: no category for weapon=" .. tostring(attribute))

                            return false
                        end

                        return
                    else
                        t1.value7("Wave.upgradeGear: GET remote not found")

                        return false
                    end

                    return
                end

                Remotes = t1.value1.RS.Assets.Remotes:FindFirstChild("GET")

                if Remotes then
                    attribute = t1.value1.Players.LocalPlayer:GetAttribute("Weapon") or Character.Lobby.autoUpgrade.weapon
                    t1.value7("Wave.upgradeGear: activeWeapon=" .. tostring(attribute))
                    v421 = Character.Gear.CATEGORIES[attribute]

                    if not v421 then
                        t1.value7("Wave.upgradeGear: no category for weapon=" .. tostring(attribute))

                        return false
                    end

                    return
                else
                    t1.value7("Wave.upgradeGear: GET remote not found")

                    return false
                end
            end
            function Character.Wave.buyUpgrade(p108)
                t1.value7("Wave.buyUpgrade: buying " .. p108)

                local Waves = Character.Actor.invoke("Waves", "Upgrade", {
					["argsExpr"] = string.format("{ %q }", p108),
					["timeout"] = 5
				})
                local v425

                if Waves == nil then
                    v425 = false
                else
                    v425 = Waves.ok
                end

                if v425 then
                    t1.value7("Wave.buyUpgrade: " .. p108 .. " -> OK")

                    return v425
                end

                local value7 = t1.value7
                local s5 = "Wave.buyUpgrade: "
                local s6 = " -> not enough Gold or maxed (err="
                local tostring_ = tostring

                if not Waves then
                    value7(s5 .. p108 .. s6 .. tostring_(Waves) .. ")")

                    return v425
                end

                Waves = Waves.err
                value7(s5 .. p108 .. s6 .. tostring_(Waves) .. ")")

                return v425
            end
            function Character.Wave.onWaveVote(p109)
                if not Character.Runtime.farming then
                    t1.value7("Wave.onWaveVote: skipped (not farming)")

                    return
                end

                if not Character.Config.WaveAutoVote then
                    t1.value7("Wave.onWaveVote: skipped (WaveAutoVote off)")

                    return
                end

                t1.value7("Wave.onWaveVote: phase=" .. tostring(p109) .. " \226\128\148 voting")

                local v428

                if p109 ~= "Start" then
                    Character.Wave.vote()

                    if p109 ~= "Skip" then
                        t1.value7("Wave.onWaveVote: phase=" .. tostring(p109) .. " \226\128\148 skipping upgrades/spears (not Skip phase)")

                        return
                    end

                    v547 = Character.Util.safeIndex(workspace, "Unclimbable", "Objective", "Waves")
                    v548 = 0

                    while true do
                        if true then
                            if v547 then
                                if v547:GetAttribute("Show") == true then
                                    v428 = v548 < 20
                                else
                                    v428 = false
                                end
                            else
                                v428 = v547
                            end
                        end

                        if not v428 then
                            t1.value7("Wave.onWaveVote: Show cleared after " .. v548 .. "s \226\128\148 proceeding with purchases")

                            if Character.Config.WaveAutoUpgradeGear then
                                Character.Wave.upgradeGear()
                            end

                            if not Character.Config.WaveAutoBuyUpgrades then
                                t1.value7("Wave.onWaveVote: done")

                                return
                            end

                            v547 = Character.Config.WaveSelectedUpgrades

                            if type(v547) == "table" then
                                v548 = #v547 > 0
                            else
                                v548 = false
                            end

                            if v548 then
                                t1.value7("Wave.onWaveVote: buying upgrades: " .. table.concat(v547, ", "))

                                for _, v in ipairs(v547) do
                                    task.wait(0.15)
                                    Character.Wave.buyUpgrade(v)
                                end
                            else
                                t1.value7("Wave.onWaveVote: no upgrades selected")
                            end

                            t1.value7("Wave.onWaveVote: done")

                            return
                        end

                        task.wait(0.5)
                        v548 = v548 + 0.5
                    end

                    return
                end

                local v431 = tick() - (Character.Runtime.sessionStartTick or 0)

                if v431 < 10 then
                    v431 = 5 - v431
                    v431 = math.max(0, v431)

                    if v431 > 0 then
                        t1.value7("Wave.onWaveVote: new session, pre-wait " .. string.format("%.1f", v431) .. "s for cutscene to spawn")
                        task.wait(v431)
                        v431 = 0
                    else
                        v431 = 0
                    end
                else
                    v431 = 0
                end

                while true do
                    v548 = Character.Features.cutsceneActive()

                    if v548 then
                        v548 = v431 < 20
                    end

                    if not v548 then
                        break
                    end

                    task.wait(0.5)
                    v431 = v431 + 0.5
                end

                t1.value7("Wave.onWaveVote: cutscene done (waited " .. v431 .. "s) \226\128\148 voting Start")
                task.wait(5)
                Character.Wave.vote()

                if p109 ~= "Skip" then
                    t1.value7("Wave.onWaveVote: phase=" .. tostring(p109) .. " \226\128\148 skipping upgrades/spears (not Skip phase)")

                    return
                end

                v431 = Character.Util.safeIndex(workspace, "Unclimbable", "Objective", "Waves")

                local n7 = 0

                while true do
                    if true then
                        if v431 then
                            if v431:GetAttribute("Show") == true then
                                v428 = n7 < 20
                            else
                                v428 = false
                            end
                        else
                            v428 = v431
                        end
                    end

                    if not v428 then
                        t1.value7("Wave.onWaveVote: Show cleared after " .. n7 .. "s \226\128\148 proceeding with purchases")

                        if Character.Config.WaveAutoUpgradeGear then
                            Character.Wave.upgradeGear()
                        end

                        if not Character.Config.WaveAutoBuyUpgrades then
                            t1.value7("Wave.onWaveVote: done")

                            return
                        end

                        v431 = Character.Config.WaveSelectedUpgrades

                        if type(v431) == "table" then
                            n7 = #v431 > 0
                        else
                            n7 = false
                        end

                        if n7 then
                            t1.value7("Wave.onWaveVote: buying upgrades: " .. table.concat(v431, ", "))

                            for _, v in ipairs(v431) do
                                task.wait(0.15)
                                Character.Wave.buyUpgrade(v)
                            end
                        else
                            t1.value7("Wave.onWaveVote: no upgrades selected")
                        end

                        t1.value7("Wave.onWaveVote: done")

                        return
                    end

                    task.wait(0.5)
                    n7 = n7 + 0.5
                end
            end

            Character.Tasks.waveMonitor = Character.Task.new("WaveMonitor", function(p110)
                t1.value7("WaveMonitor: started \226\128\148 waiting for Waves game type")

                local v435 = tick() + 60

                while true do
                    v_u_553 = p110.enabled

                    if v_u_553 then
                        v_u_553 = tick() < v435
                    end

                    if not v_u_553 or workspace:GetAttribute("Type") == "Waves" then
                        break
                    end

                    task.wait(1)
                end

                if not p110.enabled or workspace:GetAttribute("Type") ~= "Waves" then
                    t1.value7("WaveMonitor: aborted (not Waves type or disabled)")

                    return
                end

                v435 = Character.Util.safeIndex(workspace, "Unclimbable", "Objective", "Waves")

                local Objectives = t1.value1.RS:FindFirstChild("Objectives")

                if Objectives then
                    Objectives = t1.value1.RS.Objectives:FindFirstChild("Clearance")
                end

                local value7 = t1.value7
                local s7 = "WaveMonitor: wavesObj="
                local v439 = tostring(v435 and (v435:GetFullName() or "nil") or "nil")
                local s8 = " clearance="
                local tostring_ = tostring

                if Objectives then
                    v_u_559 = Objectives:GetFullName()
                else
                    v_u_559 = Objectives
                end

                value7(s7 .. v439 .. s8 .. tostring_(v_u_559 or "nil"))
                value7 = false

                if Objectives then
                    s7 = Objectives.Value
                else
                    s7 = Objectives
                end

                s7 = s7 or 0
                t1.value7("WaveMonitor: running \226\128\148 lastWaveCount=" .. tostring(s7))
                color33("Monitoring waves...")
                v439 = nil
                s8 = nil
                tostring_ = nil

                if v435 then
                    v_u_559 = v435:GetAttribute("Phase")
                else
                    v_u_559 = v435
                end

                local v_u_559_ = v_u_559 or nil

                value7 = function()
                    local attribute = v435 and v435:GetAttribute("Show") or false
                    local attribute2 = v435 and v435:GetAttribute("Phase") or "?"
                    local v445

                    if attribute then
                        v445 = not value7
                    else
                        v445 = attribute
                    end

                    if v445 then
                        value7 = true
                        t1.value7("WaveMonitor: Show=true phase=" .. tostring(attribute2) .. " \226\128\148 spawning onWaveVote")
                        task.spawn(function()
                            Character.Wave.onWaveVote(attribute2)
                        end)

                        return
                    end

                    attribute = not attribute

                    if attribute then
                        attribute = value7
                    end

                    if not attribute then
                        return
                    end

                    t1.value7("WaveMonitor: Show=false \226\128\148 vote prompt closed")
                end
                v_u_559_ = function()
                    local attribute = v435 and v435:GetAttribute("Phase") or nil

                    if attribute == v_u_559_ then
                        return
                    end

                    local v447 = v_u_559_

                    t1.value7("WaveMonitor: Phase changed " .. tostring(v447) .. " -> " .. tostring(attribute))
                    value7()
                end
                s7 = function()
                    local Value = Objectives and Objectives.Value or 0

                    if Value == s7 then
                        return
                    end

                    local v449 = s7

                    t1.value7("WaveMonitor: wave count " .. tostring(v449) .. " -> " .. tostring(Value))
                    color33("Wave " .. tostring(Value))

                    if Character.Config.WaveThreshold > 0 then
                        v449 = Character.Config.WaveThreshold <= Value
                    else
                        v449 = false
                    end

                    if not v449 then
                        return
                    end

                    t1.value7("WaveMonitor: threshold " .. Character.Config.WaveThreshold .. " reached at wave " .. Value .. " \226\128\148 stopping attack, waiting for base to fall")
                    color33("Threshold reached \226\128\148 waiting for base to fall.")
                    readfile_("Wave Farm", "Wave threshold reached. Stopping.", 4, "log-out")
                    p110.enabled = false
                    Character.Tasks.attack:stop()
                    Character.Tasks.movement:stop()
                end

                if v435 then
                    tostring_ = v435:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Show"):Connect(value7)
                    s8 = v435:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Phase"):Connect(v_u_559_)
                    value7()
                else
                    t1.value7("WaveMonitor: wavesObj nil \226\128\148 Show detection disabled, poll-only mode")
                end

                if Objectives then
                    v439 = Objectives:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Value"):Connect(s7)
                else
                    t1.value7("WaveMonitor: clearanceObj nil \226\128\148 wave count poll-only mode")
                end

                while true do
                    Objectives = p110.enabled

                    if Objectives then
                        Objectives = isfolder_()
                    end

                    if not Objectives then
                        break
                    end

                    if v435 then
                        value7()
                    end

                    s7()
                    task.wait(1)
                end

                v435 = t1.value7
                Objectives = p110.enabled
                value7 = isfolder_
                v435("WaveMonitor: loop ended \226\128\148 enabled=" .. tostring(Objectives) .. " inGame=" .. tostring(value7()))

                if tostring_ then
                    tostring_:Disconnect()
                end

                if s8 then
                    s8:Disconnect()
                end

                if not v439 then
                    color33("Idle.")

                    return
                end

                v439:Disconnect()
                color33("Idle.")
            end)

            function Character.Wave.create()
                t1.value7("Wave.create: difficulty=Easy")

                local S_Missions = Character.Actor.invoke("S_Missions", "Create", {
					["argsExpr"] = "{ Name = \"Trost\", Difficulty = \"Easy\", Type = \"Waves\", Objective = \"Waves\" }",
					["mapExpr"] = "        if typeof(res) == \"Instance\" and res.Name then\n            out = { ok = true, name = res.Name, mtype = res:GetAttribute(\"Type\") }\n        else\n            out = { ok = false, retType = typeof(res), retVal = tostring(res) }\n        end\n    ",
					["timeout"] = 10
				})

                if not S_Missions then
                    t1.value7("Wave.create: nil (timeout/no actor)")

                    return nil
                end

                local data = S_Missions.data

                if not (not S_Missions.ok or (type(data) ~= "table" and true or not data.ok)) then
                    S_Missions = t1.value7
                    v569 = data.name
                    S_Missions("Wave.create: OK name=" .. tostring(v569))

                    return {
						["ok"] = true,
						["name"] = data.name,
						["mtype"] = data.mtype
					}
                end

                S_Missions = t1.value7

                local s9 = "Wave.create: rejected type="

                if data then
                    v570 = data.retType
                else
                    v570 = data
                end

                local v456 = tostring(v570)
                local s10 = " val="
                local tostring_ = tostring

                if not data then
                    S_Missions(s9 .. v456 .. s10 .. tostring_(data))

                    return {
						["ok"] = false
					}
                end

                data = data.retVal
                S_Missions(s9 .. v456 .. s10 .. tostring_(data))

                return {
					["ok"] = false
				}
            end
            function Character.Wave.createStartOnce()
                return color34("Wave", color33, Character.Wave.create, {}, "Waves")
            end

            Character.Tasks.autoWave = Character.Task.new("AutoWave", function(p111)
                t1.value7("autoWave: task started")

                local n8 = 0

                while p111.enabled do
                    if isfolder_() then
                        t1.value7("autoWave: already in game \226\128\148 stopping loop")
                        color33("Stopped \226\128\148 entered game.")

                        break
                    end

                    if Character.Lobby.anyLobbyBusy() then
                        t1.value7("autoWave: busy wait \226\128\148 " .. Character.Lobby.busyNames())
                    end

                    while true do
                        v575 = p111.enabled and Character.Lobby.anyLobbyBusy()

                        if v575 then
                            v575 = not isfolder_()
                        end

                        if not v575 then
                            break
                        end

                        color33("Waiting: " .. Character.Lobby.busyNames() .. " still running...")
                        task.wait(2)
                    end

                    if not p111.enabled or isfolder_() then
                        t1.value7("autoWave: task ended")
                        color33("Idle.")

                        return
                    end

                    t1.value7("autoWave: attempting createStartOnce (attempt #" .. n8 + 1 .. ")")

                    local t17 = { Character.Wave.createStartOnce() }
                    local v458 = t17[2]

                    if t17[1] then
                        t1.value7("autoWave: session created OK \226\128\148 waiting for teleport")
                        n8 = tick() + 30

                        while true do
                            t17 = p111.enabled

                            if t17 then
                                if tick() < n8 then
                                    t17 = not isfolder_()
                                else
                                    t17 = false
                                end
                            end

                            if not t17 then
                                break
                            end

                            task.wait(1)
                        end

                        n8 = isfolder_
                        t1.value7("autoWave: post-session wait done inGame=" .. tostring(n8()))

                        break
                    end

                    n8 = n8 + 1
                    t1.value7("autoWave: fail #" .. n8 .. " reason=" .. tostring(v458))
                    color33("Failed (" .. n8 .. "x) retrying...")
                    t17 = task.wait
                    v458 = n8 * 2 - 1
                    t17((math.clamp(v458, 1, 6)))
                end

                t1.value7("autoWave: task ended")
                color33("Idle.")
            end)

            function Character.Thunder.readProgress()
                local t18 = {}
                local questCache = {}

                for _, quest in ipairs(Character.Thunder.QUESTS) do
                    for _, tag in ipairs(quest.tags) do
                        t18[tag] = true
                    end
                end

                local v467 = Character.Util.safeIndex(t1.value4, "Interface")

                if not v467 then
                    return questCache
                end

                local v468, v469

                v467, v468, v469 = ipairs(v467:GetDescendants())

                while true do
                    local Parent

                    v469, Parent = v467(v468, v469)

                    if not v469 then
                        break
                    end

                    local isTextLabel

                    if Parent.Name == "Tag" then
                        isTextLabel = Parent:IsA("TextLabel")
                    else
                        isTextLabel = false
                    end

                    if isTextLabel then
                        isTextLabel = Parent.Text
                        isTextLabel = tostring(isTextLabel):upper()

                        if t18[isTextLabel] then
                            Parent = Parent.Parent
                            local v473 = Character.Util.safeIndex(Parent, "Bar", "Amount")
                            local v474
                            local match
                            local isTextLabel2
                            if v473 then
                                isTextLabel2 = v473:IsA("TextLabel")
                            else
                                isTextLabel2 = v473
                            end
                            if isTextLabel2 then
                                match, v474 = v473.Text:match("([%d%.]+)%s*/%s*([%d%.]+)")
                            end
                            Parent = Character.Util.safeIndex(Parent, "Claimed")
                            if Parent then
                                v473 = Character.Util.safeIndex(Parent, "Title")
                            end
                            v473 = (v473 and (v473:IsA("TextLabel") and v473.Text) or ""):upper()
                            local u476 = false
                            Parent = function()
                                local isGuiObject = Parent

                                if isGuiObject then
                                    isGuiObject = Parent:IsA("GuiObject")
                                end

                                if not isGuiObject then
                                    return
                                end

                                u476 = Parent.Visible
                            end
                            pcall(Parent)
                            Parent = u476
                            if Parent then
                                Parent = v473:find("LOCK") ~= nil
                            end
                            v473 = u476
                            if v473 then
                                v473 = not Parent
                            end
                            questCache[isTextLabel] = {
								["current"] = tonumber(match) or 0,
								["target"] = tonumber(v474) or 0,
								["claimed"] = v473,
								["locked"] = Parent
							}
                        end
                    end
                end

                if not next(questCache) then
                    return questCache
                end

                Character.Lobby.questCache = questCache

                return questCache
            end
            function Character.Thunder.missionDone(p113, p114)
                for _, tag in ipairs(p113.tags) do
                    local v480 = p114[tag]
                    local claimed

                    if v480 then
                        claimed = v480.claimed

                        if not claimed then
                            if v480.target > 0 then
                                claimed = v480.current >= v480.target
                            else
                                claimed = false
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        claimed = v480
                    end

                    if not claimed then
                        return false
                    end
                end

                return true
            end
            function Character.Thunder.missionProgressStr(p115, p116)
                local t19 = {}

                for _, tag in ipairs(p115.tags) do
                    local v486 = p116[tag]

                    t19[#t19 + 1] = tag .. " " .. (v486 and v486.claimed and "\226\156\147" or (v486.current .. "/" .. v486.target or "?"))
                end

                return table.concat(t19, ", ")
            end
            function Character.Thunder.nextQuest(p117)
                local thunderRan = Character.Lobby.thunderRan or {}

                for _, quest in ipairs(Character.Thunder.QUESTS) do
                    local v489 = not Character.Thunder.missionDone(quest, p117)

                    if v489 then
                        v489 = not thunderRan[quest.name]
                    end

                    if v489 then
                        return quest, p117
                    end
                end

                return nil
            end

                        if not p118:IsDescendantOf(t1.value4) then
                            return false
                        end

                        return
                    else
                        return false
                    end

                    return
                else
                    return false
                end
            end

                    if v494 then
                        if not v494 then
                            t1.value7("Thunder.openPanelAndRead: Quests category Interact not ready, waiting 3s")
                            task.wait(3)

                            return {}
                        end

                        return
                    end

                    task.wait(0.5)

                    if v491 < tick() then
                        v494 = nil

                        if not v494 then
                            t1.value7("Thunder.openPanelAndRead: Quests category Interact not ready, waiting 3s")
                            task.wait(3)

                            return {}
                        end

                        return
                    end
                end
            end
            function Character.Thunder.runQuestSession(p120)
                local missionMap = Character.Lobby.missionMap
                local missionObjective = Character.Lobby.missionObjective
                local missionDifficulty = Character.Lobby.missionDifficulty
                local missionModifiers = Character.Lobby.missionModifiers

                Character.Lobby.questOverride = true
                Character.Lobby.missionMap = p120.map
                Character.Lobby.missionObjective = p120.objective

                if not p120.difficulty then
                    Character.Lobby.missionModifiers = {}
                    v625 = t1.value7
                    v626 = p120.name
                    v627 = Character.Lobby.missionMap
                    v627 = "map=" .. tostring(v627)
                    v628 = Character.Lobby.missionObjective
                    v628 = "obj=" .. tostring(v628)
                    v629 = Character.Lobby.missionDifficulty
                    v629 = "diff=" .. tostring(v629)
                    v630 = p120.difficulty or "any"
                    v625("Thunder.runQuestSession:", v626, v627, v628, v629, "(required=" .. tostring(v630) .. ", modifiers cleared)")
                    v625, v626 = pcall(Character.Mission.createStartOnce)
                    v627 = Character.Lobby
                    v628 = Character.Lobby
                    v629 = Character.Lobby
                    v627.missionMap = missionMap
                    v628.missionObjective = missionObjective
                    v629.missionDifficulty = missionDifficulty
                    Character.Lobby.missionModifiers = missionModifiers
                    Character.Lobby.questOverride = false

                    if v625 then
                        return v626
                    else
                        t1.value7("Thunder.runQuestSession: createStartOnce threw:", v626)

                        return false
                    end

                    return
                end

                Character.Lobby.missionDifficulty = p120.difficulty
                Character.Lobby.missionModifiers = {}

                local value7 = t1.value7
                local name = p120.name
                local missionMap2 = Character.Lobby.missionMap

                missionMap2 = "map=" .. tostring(missionMap2)

                local missionObjective2 = Character.Lobby.missionObjective

                missionObjective2 = "obj=" .. tostring(missionObjective2)

                local missionDifficulty2 = Character.Lobby.missionDifficulty

                missionDifficulty2 = "diff=" .. tostring(missionDifficulty2)

                local difficulty = p120.difficulty or "any"

                value7("Thunder.runQuestSession:", name, missionMap2, missionObjective2, missionDifficulty2, "(required=" .. tostring(difficulty) .. ", modifiers cleared)")
                value7, name = pcall(Character.Mission.createStartOnce)
                missionMap2 = Character.Lobby
                missionObjective2 = Character.Lobby
                missionDifficulty2 = Character.Lobby
                missionMap2.missionMap = missionMap
                missionObjective2.missionObjective = missionObjective
                missionDifficulty2.missionDifficulty = missionDifficulty
                Character.Lobby.missionModifiers = missionModifiers
                Character.Lobby.questOverride = false

                if value7 then
                    return name
                else
                    t1.value7("Thunder.runQuestSession: createStartOnce threw:", name)

                    return false
                end
            end

            color35 = function(p121)
                local v504
                local function v505()
                    local Hitbox = v504:FindFirstChild("Hitbox", true)
                    if Hitbox then
                        v634 = Hitbox:IsA("BasePart")
                    else
                        v634 = Hitbox
                    end
                    if v634 then
                        return Hitbox
                    end
                    for v508, v509 in ipairs(v504:GetDescendants()) do

                        local isBasePart = v509:IsA("BasePart")

                        if isBasePart then
                            isBasePart = v509:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("TouchTransmitter")
                        end

                        if isBasePart then
                            return v509
                        end
                    end
                    if v504:IsA("BasePart") then
                        return v504
                    end
                    Hitbox = v504:IsA("Model")
                    if not Hitbox then
                        if Hitbox then
                            return v504.PrimaryPart
                        else
                            Hitbox = v504

                            return Hitbox:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                        end

                        return
                    end
                    Hitbox = v504.PrimaryPart
                    if Hitbox then
                        return v504.PrimaryPart
                    else
                        Hitbox = v504

                        return Hitbox:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)
                    end
                end
                v504 = p121
                local result
                v505, result = pcall(v505)

                return v505 and result and result or nil
            end
            Character.Thunder.SUPPLY_PATTERN = "^thunderspear_supplies"
            Character.Thunder.CRATE_PATTERN = "^supplies_c"
            Character.Thunder.TOWER_PATTERN = "^watchtower_(%d+)"
            Character.Thunder.ESCORT_PATTERN = "^escort$"

            function Character.Thunder.crateTarget()
                local Unclimbable = workspace:FindFirstChild("Unclimbable")
                local Objective

                if Unclimbable then
                    Objective = Unclimbable:FindFirstChild("Objective") or nil
                else
                    Objective = nil
                end

                Unclimbable = { Objective, Unclimbable, workspace }

                for _, v in ipairs(Unclimbable) do
                    if v then
                        for _, child in ipairs(v:GetChildren()) do
                            if child.Name:lower():match(Character.Thunder.CRATE_PATTERN) then
                                local v518 = color35(child)
                                local isBasePart

                                if v518 then
                                    isBasePart = v518:IsA("BasePart")
                                else
                                    isBasePart = v518
                                end

                                if isBasePart then
                                    return child, v518
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                return nil, nil
            end
            function Character.Thunder.defendSuppliesNode()
                for _, v in ipairs({ t1.value1.RS:FindFirstChild("Objectives"), Character.Util.safeIndex(workspace, "Unclimbable", "Objective") }) do
                    if v then
                        local Defend_Supplies = v:FindFirstChild("Defend_Supplies")
                        local Parent

                        if Defend_Supplies then
                            Parent = Defend_Supplies.Parent
                        else
                            Parent = Defend_Supplies
                        end

                        if Parent then
                            return Defend_Supplies
                        end
                    end
                end

                return nil
            end
            function Character.Thunder.defendSuppliesDone()
                local Value = Character.Thunder.defendSuppliesNode()

                if Value then
                    local attribute = Value:GetAttribute("Requirement")

                    Value = Value.Value
                    Value = tonumber(Value)

                    if attribute == nil or (Value == nil or attribute <= 0) then
                        Value = false
                    else
                        Value = attribute <= Value
                    end

                    return Value
                else
                    return false
                end
            end

            Character.Thunder.SUPPLY_GUARD_RADIUS = 150
            Character.Thunder._sawDefend = false

            function Character.Thunder.defendingSuppliesActive()
                local Value = Character.Thunder.defendSuppliesNode()

                if Value then
                    local attribute = Value:GetAttribute("Requirement")

                    Value = Value.Value
                    Value = tonumber(Value)

                    if attribute then
                        if not Value then
                            if Value then
                                return false
                            else
                                Character.Thunder._sawDefend = true

                                return true
                            end

                            return
                        end

                        if attribute > 0 then
                            Value = attribute <= Value
                        else
                            Value = false
                        end
                    else
                        Value = attribute
                    end

                    if Value then
                        return false
                    else
                        Character.Thunder._sawDefend = true

                        return true
                    end

                    return
                else
                    return false
                end
            end
            function Character.Thunder.supplyPos()
                local value = select(2, Character.Thunder.crateTarget())

                if not value then
                    return value or nil
                end

                value = value.Position

                return value or nil
            end
            function Character.Thunder.slayNode()
                for _, v in ipairs({ t1.value1.RS:FindFirstChild("Objectives"), Character.Util.safeIndex(workspace, "Unclimbable", "Objective") }) do
                    if v then
                        local Slay = v:FindFirstChild("Slay") or v:FindFirstChild("Kill")
                        local Parent

                        if Slay then
                            Parent = Slay.Parent
                        else
                            Parent = Slay
                        end

                        if Parent then
                            return Slay
                        end
                    end
                end

                return nil
            end
            function Character.Thunder.shouldLeaveDefendPhase()
                if Character.Thunder.defendSuppliesDone() then
                    return "defend done (1/1)"
                end

                local _sawDefend = Character.Thunder._sawDefend
                local attribute, v535

                if not _sawDefend then
                    if _sawDefend then
                        return "defend objective vanished (failed/removed)"
                    else
                        _sawDefend = Character.Thunder._sawDefend and Character.Thunder.slayNode()

                        if _sawDefend then
                            attribute = _sawDefend:GetAttribute("Requirement")
                            _sawDefend = _sawDefend.Value
                            _sawDefend = tonumber(_sawDefend)

                            if attribute then
                                if _sawDefend then
                                    if attribute > 0 then
                                        v535 = attribute - 10 <= _sawDefend
                                    else
                                        v535 = false
                                    end
                                else
                                    v535 = _sawDefend
                                end
                            else
                                v535 = attribute
                            end

                            if v535 then
                                return "Slay near requirement (" .. _sawDefend .. "/" .. attribute .. ")"
                            else
                                return nil
                            end

                            return
                        else
                            return nil
                        end

                        return
                    end

                    return
                end

                _sawDefend = not Character.Thunder.defendSuppliesNode()

                if _sawDefend then
                    return "defend objective vanished (failed/removed)"
                else
                    _sawDefend = Character.Thunder._sawDefend and Character.Thunder.slayNode()

                    if _sawDefend then
                        attribute = _sawDefend:GetAttribute("Requirement")
                        _sawDefend = _sawDefend.Value
                        _sawDefend = tonumber(_sawDefend)

                        if attribute then
                            if _sawDefend then
                                if attribute > 0 then
                                    v535 = attribute - 10 <= _sawDefend
                                else
                                    v535 = false
                                end
                            else
                                v535 = _sawDefend
                            end
                        else
                            v535 = attribute
                        end

                        if v535 then
                            return "Slay near requirement (" .. _sawDefend .. "/" .. attribute .. ")"
                        else
                            return nil
                        end

                        return
                    else
                        return nil
                    end

                    return
                end
            end
            function Character.Thunder.activeTower()
                local CS = t1.value1.CS
                local n9 = 0
                local v538
                local result
                CS, result = pcall(function()
                    return CS:GetTagged("TS_Towers")
                end)
                if not (CS and result) then
                    return v538, n9
                end
                for _, v in ipairs(result) do
                    local Parent = v.Parent

                    if Parent then
                        Parent = v.Name:lower():match(Character.Thunder.TOWER_PATTERN)
                    end

                    if Parent then
                        n9 = n9 + 1
                        Parent = color35(v)

                        local isBasePart

                        if Parent then
                            isBasePart = Parent:IsA("BasePart")
                        else
                            isBasePart = Parent
                        end

                        if isBasePart then
                            isBasePart = v.Name
                            isBasePart = tonumber(isBasePart:match("_(%d+)$")) or 0

                            if not v538 or isBasePart < v538.n then
                                v538 = {
									["inst"] = v,
									["part"] = Parent,
									["n"] = isBasePart
								}
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                return v538, n9
            end
            function Character.Thunder.escortTarget()
                local Unclimbable = workspace:FindFirstChild("Unclimbable")
                local Objective

                if Unclimbable then
                    Objective = Unclimbable:FindFirstChild("Objective") or nil
                else
                    Objective = nil
                end

                Unclimbable = { Objective, Unclimbable, workspace }

                for _, v in ipairs(Unclimbable) do
                    if v then
                        for _, child in ipairs(v:GetChildren()) do
                            local Collider = not child.Name:lower():match(Character.Thunder.ESCORT_PATTERN) and child:FindFirstChild("Collider")

                            if Collider then
                                Collider = child:FindFirstChild("Cart")
                            end

                            if Collider then
                                Collider = child:FindFirstChild("Collider", true)

                                local isBasePart

                                if Collider then
                                    isBasePart = Collider:IsA("BasePart")
                                else
                                    isBasePart = Collider
                                end

                                if isBasePart then
                                    return child, Collider
                                end

                                Collider = color35(child)

                                if Collider then
                                    isBasePart = Collider:IsA("BasePart")
                                else
                                    isBasePart = Collider
                                end

                                if isBasePart then
                                    return child, Collider
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                return nil, nil
            end

            color36 = Character.Tasks
            color3 = Character.Task.new

            function onClose.value3(p122)
                local t20 = {}
                local function v553(p123)
                    local Unclimbable = workspace:FindFirstChild("Unclimbable")
                    local Objective
                    if Unclimbable then
                        Objective = Unclimbable:FindFirstChild("Objective") or nil
                    else
                        Objective = nil
                    end
                    Unclimbable = { Objective, Unclimbable, workspace }
                    local v556
                    local v557
                    local v558
                    for _, v in ipairs(Unclimbable) do
                        if v then
                            local GetChildren = v.GetChildren

                            for _, v2 in ipairs(GetChildren(v)) do

                                        if not v556 or isBasePart < v556 then
                                            v558 = v564
                                            v557 = v2
                                            v556 = isBasePart
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    return v557, v558
                end
                local v566
                local now
                local now2
                local s11 = "PICKUP"
                local v571
                local Parent
                local Magnitude
                local now3
                while true do
                    local enabled = p122.enabled

                    if enabled then
                        enabled = isfolder_()
                    end

                    if not enabled then
                        Character.Move.cancel()

                        return
                    end

                    task.wait(0.1)
                    enabled = select(2, Character.Char.get())

                    if enabled then
                        local part = Character.Thunder.activeTower()
                        local v576 = Character
                        local v577 = part ~= nil
                        local result

                        v576, result = v576.Thunder.escortTarget()

                        if v576 == nil then
                            v576 = false
                        else

                        end

                        if v577 then
                            Character.Runtime.objectiveMode = true

                            if v566 ~= part.n then
                                v566 = part.n
                                tick()
                                Character.Move.cancel()
                                t1.value7("ThunderObjective: TOWERS -> holding WatchTower_" .. tostring(v566))
                                color33("Towers: building WatchTower_" .. tostring(v566))
                            end

                            part = part.part

                            if part then
                                v576 = part.Parent
                            else
                                v576 = part
                            end

                            if v576 then
                                v576 = part.Position
                                part, v577 = pcall(function()
                                    return part.Size.Z * 0.5
                                end)
                                part = part and v577 and v577 or 100
                                v577 = part * 0.92
                                v577 = math.max(8, v577)
                                result = Character
                                v576 = v576 + Vector3.new(0, v577, 0)
                                part = result.Combat.chaseHold(v576, part, v577)

                                if (enabled.Position - part).Magnitude > 12 then
                                    Character.Move.to(enabled, part)
                                else
                                    Character.Move.hold(enabled)
                                end
                            end
                        elseif v576 then
                            Character.Runtime.objectiveMode = true
                            part = Character.Config.HoverHeight
                            part = tonumber(part) or 200
                            Character.Move.to(enabled, result.Position + Vector3.new(0, part, 0))
                            color33("Escort: following cart")
                        elseif v579 then
                            Character.Runtime.objectiveMode = true

                            if Parent and Parent.Parent then
                                v576 = Parent
                                part = Magnitude
                            elseif s11 == "PICKUP" then
                                part, v576 = v553(enabled)

                                if part then
                                    t1.value7("ThunderObjective: PICKUP", part:GetFullName())
                                    color33("Carrying: picking up " .. part.Name)
                                    Character.Move.to(enabled, v576.Position)
                                    v571 = part
                                    now3 = nil
                                else
                                    v576 = Parent
                                    part = Magnitude
                                end
                            else

                                if part and v576 then
                                    t1.value7("ThunderObjective: DROPOFF to", part:GetFullName())

                                    now3 = nil

                                    v576 = Parent

                                    else

                                    end
                                else

                                end

                                    if now2 then
                                        Parent = tick() - now2 > 8
                                    else

                                    end

                                        end)

                                            Parent = false
                                        else
                                            Parent = true
                                        end

                                                enabled.CFrame = CFrame.new(v576.Position)
                                                now2 = tick()

                                            Character.Move.hold(enabled)

                                            if tick() - now2 >= 1.5 then
                                                t1.value7("ThunderObjective: picked up", v571 and (v571.Name or "?") or "?")

                                                Parent = v576

                                    Parent = v576
                                end

                                else

                                    s11 = "PICKUP"

                                    Parent = nil
                                    Magnitude = nil
                                    now3 = nil
                                else

                                            Parent = v576.Parent
                                        else
                                            Parent = v576
                                        end
                                    else
                                        Parent = part
                                    end

                                        if now3 then
                                            Parent = tick() - now3 > 6
                                        else
                                            Parent = now3
                                        end

                                        if Parent then
                                            t1.value7("ThunderObjective: dropoff re-approach", v571 and (v571.Name or "?") or "?")

                                            now3 = tick()

                                            Parent = v576

                                                local Size = v576.Size
                                                local X = Size.X
                                                local Y = Size.Y

                                                Size = Size.Z

                                                return math.max(X, Y, Size) * 0.5 + 4
                                            end)

                                                Parent = false

                                            end

                                    Character.Runtime.objectiveMode = false
                                end

                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
