            function Character.Thunder.beginFarming()
                local value7 = t1.value7
                local v589 = isfolder_

                v589 = tostring(v589())

                local farming = Character.Runtime.farming

                farming = tostring(farming)

                local v591 = Character.Thunder._savedLobby ~= nil

                v591 = tostring(v591)

                local HoverHeight = Character.Config.HoverHeight

                value7("Thunder.beginFarming: inGame=" .. v589 .. " farming=" .. farming .. " alreadyArmed=" .. v591 .. " hoverHeight=" .. tostring(HoverHeight))

                if Character.Tasks.thunderObjective:isRunning() then
                    Character.Runtime.objectiveMode = true

                    return
                end

                if not Character.Thunder._savedLobby then
                    Character.Thunder._savedLobby = {
						["on"] = Character.Config.AutoLobby,
						["after"] = Character.Config.AutoLobbyAfter
					}
                    Character.Runtime.objectiveMode = true

                    if Character.Runtime.farming then
                        Character.Thunder._startedFarm = false
                    else
                        Character.Farm.start()
                        Character.Thunder._startedFarm = true
                    end

                    Character.Tasks.thunderObjective:start()
                    t1.value7("Thunder.beginFarming: navigator running =", Character.Tasks.thunderObjective:isRunning(), "startedFarm =", Character.Thunder._startedFarm)

                    return
                end

                Character.Runtime.objectiveMode = true

                if Character.Runtime.farming then
                    Character.Tasks.thunderObjective:start()

                    return
                end

                Character.Farm.start()
                Character.Thunder._startedFarm = true
                Character.Tasks.thunderObjective:start()
            end
            function Character.Thunder.endFarming()
                local u593 = false

                local function v594()
                    local Flags = Character.UI.Window and Character.UI.Window.Flags

                    if Flags then
                        Flags = Character.UI.Window.Flags.AutoFarm
                    end

                    local v596

                    if Flags then
                        v596 = Flags.Value ~= nil
                    else
                        v596 = Flags
                    end

                    if not v596 then
                        return
                    end

                    u593 = Flags.Value == true
                end

                pcall(v594)
                v594 = Character.Thunder._startedFarm

                if v594 then
                    v594 = not u593
                end

                local value7 = t1.value7
                local v598 = tostring(v594)
                local _startedFarm = Character.Thunder._startedFarm
                local v600 = u593

                value7("Thunder.endFarming: stopping navigator; stopFarm=" .. v598 .. " (startedFarm=" .. tostring(_startedFarm) .. " userFarmOn=" .. tostring(v600) .. ")")
                Character.Runtime.objectiveMode = false
                Character.Tasks.thunderObjective:stop()

                if v594 then
                    v594 = Character.Runtime.farming
                end

                if not v594 then
                    Character.Thunder._startedFarm = nil
                    Character.Thunder._savedLobby = nil

                    return
                end

                Character.Farm.stop()
                Character.Thunder._startedFarm = nil
                Character.Thunder._savedLobby = nil
            end

            Character.Colossal = {}
            Character.Colossal.SHOOT_COOLDOWN = 5
            Character.Colossal.MOUNT_RADIUS = 4000
            Character.Colossal.IMPACT_BURST_MIN = 10
            Character.Colossal.IMPACT_BURST_MAX = 10
            Character.Colossal.SHOOT_BASE = 0
            Character.Colossal.SHOOT_BARREL = 40

            function Character.Colossal.boss()
                local Titans = workspace:FindFirstChild("Titans")
                local Parent

                if not Titans then
                    if Titans then
                        Parent = Titans.Parent
                    else
                        Parent = Titans
                    end

                    return Parent and Titans and Titans or nil
                end

                Titans = Titans:FindFirstChild("Colossal_Titan")

                if Titans then
                    Parent = Titans.Parent
                else
                    Parent = Titans
                end

                return Parent and Titans and Titans or nil
            end
            function Character.Colossal.active()
                local v603

                if workspace:GetAttribute("Objective") == "Colossal Titan" then
                    v603 = Character.Colossal.boss() ~= nil
                else
                    v603 = false
                end

                return v603
            end

            Character.Colossal.EREN_GUARD_RADIUS = 120

            function Character.Colossal.erenPos()
                local v604 = Character.Util.safeIndex(workspace, "Unclimbable", "Objective")

                if v604 then
                    for _, child in ipairs(v604:GetChildren()) do
                        if child.Name:match("^Defend_Eren") then
                            local Collider = child:FindFirstChild("Collider") or (child:FindFirstChild("Hitbox") or child:FindFirstChild("RootPart"))
                            local isBasePart

                            if Collider then
                                isBasePart = Collider:IsA("BasePart")
                            else
                                isBasePart = Collider
                            end

                            if isBasePart then
                                return Collider.Position
                            end

                            Collider = child:IsA("Model")

                            if Collider then
                                Collider = child.PrimaryPart
                            end

                            if Collider then
                                return child:GetPivot().Position
                            end

                            local BasePart = child:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart", true)

                            if BasePart then
                                return BasePart.Position
                            end
                        end
                    end

                    return nil
                else
                    return nil
                end
            end
            function Character.Colossal.phase()
                local attribute = Character.Colossal.boss()

                if attribute then
                    attribute = attribute:GetAttribute("Phase")

                    if attribute == 2 then
                        return 2
                    else
                        if attribute == 1 then
                            return 1
                        else
                            attribute = t1.value1.RS:FindFirstChild("Objectives")

                            if attribute then
                                if attribute:FindFirstChild("Defeat_Colossal_Titan") then
                                    return 2
                                else
                                    if attribute:FindFirstChild("Stall_Colossal_Titan") then
                                        return 1
                                    else
                                        return 1
                                    end

                                    return
                                end

                                return
                            else
                                return 1
                            end

                            return
                        end

                        return
                    end

                    return
                else
                    attribute = t1.value1.RS:FindFirstChild("Objectives")

                    if attribute then
                        if attribute:FindFirstChild("Defeat_Colossal_Titan") then
                            return 2
                        else
                            if attribute:FindFirstChild("Stall_Colossal_Titan") then
                                return 1
                            else
                                return 1
                            end

                            return
                        end

                        return
                    else
                        return 1
                    end

                    return
                end
            end
            function Character.Colossal.cannons()
                local CS = t1.value1.CS
                local value = Character.Colossal.boss()
                local PrimaryPart = value and value.PrimaryPart

                if PrimaryPart then
                    PrimaryPart = value.PrimaryPart.Position
                end

                value = select(2, Character.Char.get())

                if value then
                    value = value.Position
                end

                local t21 = {}

                for _, v in ipairs(CS:GetTagged("Cannon")) do
                    local Parent = v.Parent

                    if Parent then
                        Parent = v:FindFirstChild("Base")
                    end

                    if Parent then
                        Parent = v:GetAttribute("Player")

                        if not Parent or Parent == t1.value3.Name then
                            Parent = v.Base

                            local Magnitude

                            if PrimaryPart then
                                Magnitude = (PrimaryPart - Parent.Position).Magnitude
                            else
                                Magnitude = PrimaryPart
                            end

                            if not PrimaryPart or (Magnitude or 0) <= Character.Colossal.MOUNT_RADIUS then
                                Magnitude = value and ((value - Parent.Position).Magnitude or 0) or 0
                                t21[#t21 + 1] = {
									["inst"] = v,
									["part"] = Parent,
									["dist"] = Magnitude
								}
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end

                table.sort(t21, function(p124, p125)
                    return p124.dist < p125.dist
                end)

                return t21
            end
            function Character.Colossal.rotationLock(p126)
                if p126 then
                    if Character.Conn.ColossalRotLock then
                        return
                    end

                    return
                end

                if not Character.Conn.ColossalRotLock then
                    return
                end

                Character.Connection.disconnect("ColossalRotLock")

                local Character2 = t1.value3.Character
                local Humanoid

                if Character2 then
                    Humanoid = Character2:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                else
                    Humanoid = Character2
                end

                if Humanoid then
                    Humanoid.AutoRotate = true
                end

                if Character2 then
                    Character2 = Character2:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                end

                if Character2 then
                    Character2 = Character2:FindFirstChild("BG")
                end

                if Character2 then
                    Humanoid = Character2:IsA("AlignOrientation")
                else
                    Humanoid = Character2
                end

                if Humanoid then
                    Character2.Enabled = true
                end

                t1.value7("Colossal: rotation lock OFF")
            end
            function Character.Colossal.installVFXGuard()
                local Cache = Character.Util.safeIndex(t1.value1.RS, "Assets", "Particles", "Cannon", "Explosion")

                if Cache then
                    local n10 = 0

                    for _, descendant in ipairs(Cache:GetDescendants()) do
                        if descendant:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
                            descendant:Destroy()
                            n10 = n10 + 1
                        end

                        if descendant:IsA("Light") then
                            descendant.Enabled = false
                            descendant.Brightness = 0
                        end
                    end

                    if n10 > 0 then
                        t1.value7("Colossal VFXGuard: stripped " .. n10 .. " emitters from Cannon.Explosion template")
                    end
                end

                Cache = Character.Util.safeIndex(t1.value1.RS, "Assets", "Objects", "Template_Debris")

                if Cache then
                    v759 = Cache:IsA("BasePart")
                else
                    v759 = Cache
                end

                if v759 then
                    Cache.Transparency = 1
                    Cache.CastShadow = false
                    t1.value7("Colossal VFXGuard: Template_Debris made invisible")
                end

                Cache = t1.value1.RS:FindFirstChild("Cache")

                if not Cache then
                    return
                end

                local GetDescendants = Cache.GetDescendants

                for _, v in ipairs(GetDescendants(Cache)) do
                    local isBasePart

                    if v.Name == "Template_Debris" then
                        isBasePart = v:IsA("BasePart")
                    else
                        isBasePart = false
                    end

                    if isBasePart then
                        v.Transparency = 1
                        v.CastShadow = false
                    end
                end
            end
            function Character.Colossal.fireCycle(p127, _, _)
                if p127 then
                    if Character.Colossal._firing then
                        return
                    end

                    return
                else
                    return
                end
            end

            function onClose.value3(p128)
                local inst
                local v631
                local n11 = 0
                while true do
                    local enabled = p128.enabled

                    if enabled then
                        enabled = isfolder_()
                    end

                    if not enabled then
                        inst = nil
                        Character.Colossal._firing = false
                        Character.Colossal.rotationLock(false)
                        Character.Move.cancel()
                        Character.Move.cancel()

                        return
                    end

                    task.wait(0.1)

                    if Character.Colossal.active() then
                        enabled = select(2, Character.Char.get())

                        if not enabled then
                            continue
                        end

                        local Position = Character.Colossal.boss()

                        Position = Position and (Position.PrimaryPart and Position.PrimaryPart.Position) or nil

                        local v635 = Character.Colossal.phase()

                        if v635 ~= v631 then
                            readfile_("Colossal Raid", v635 == 1 and "Stall phase manning cannon" or "Defeat phase attacking Bertholdt", 4, "crosshair")
                            t1.value7("Colossal: phase " .. tostring(v631) .. " -> " .. tostring(v635))
                            v631 = v635
                        end

                        if v635 == 2 then
                            enabled = tick()

                            while true do
                                Position = Character.Colossal._firing

                                if Position then
                                    Position = tick() - enabled < 12
                                end

                                if not Position then
                                    break
                                end

                                task.wait(0.1)

                                continue
                            end

                            inst = nil
                            Character.Colossal._firing = false
                            Character.Colossal.rotationLock(false)
                            Character.Move.cancel()
                            Character.Runtime.objectiveMode = false

                            continue
                        else
                            local Objectives, Value

                            if v635 == 1 then
                                Objectives = t1.value1.RS:FindFirstChild("Objectives")

                                if Objectives then
                                    Objectives = Objectives:FindFirstChild("Stall_Colossal_Titan")
                                end

                                if Objectives then
                                    Value = Objectives.Value or 0
                                    Objectives = Objectives:GetAttribute("Requirement") or 0

                                    if Objectives > 0 then
                                        Objectives = Objectives <= Value
                                    else
                                        Objectives = false
                                    end

                                    if Objectives then
                                        inst = nil
                                        Character.Colossal._firing = false
                                        Character.Colossal.rotationLock(false)
                                        Character.Move.cancel()
                                        Character.Runtime.objectiveMode = false
                                        v635 = -1
                                    end
                                end
                            end

                            if v635 == -1 then
                                continue
                            end

                            Character.Runtime.objectiveMode = true

                            local v637, v638, v639

                            if not (inst and inst.Parent) then
                                inst = nil
                                v635 = Character.Colossal.cannons()[1]

                                if v635 then
                                    inst = v635.inst
                                    n11 = 0
                                    v635 = inst:FindFirstChild("Base")

                                    if v635 then
                                        v635 = v635.Position
                                        Objectives = tick() - n11
                                        Value = (enabled.Position - v635).Magnitude

                                        if Position then
                                            v637 = Character.Colossal.SHOOT_COOLDOWN <= Objectives
                                        else
                                            v637 = Position
                                        end

                                        v638 = enabled:FindFirstChild("Cannon") ~= nil
                                        v637 = not v637

                                        if v637 then
                                            v637 = not (Character.Colossal._firing or v638)

                                            if v637 then
                                                v637 = Character.Colossal.SHOOT_COOLDOWN - Objectives > 1.5
                                            end
                                        end

                                        if v637 then
                                            v637 = Character.Colossal.erenPos()
                                            v638, v639 = Character.Target.smallTitanNape(v637 or v635)

                                            if v638 then
                                                if v637 then
                                                    v637 = (v637 - v638.Position).Magnitude <= Character.Colossal.EREN_GUARD_RADIUS
                                                end
                                            else
                                                v637 = v638
                                            end

                                            if v637 then
                                                Character.Colossal.rotationLock(false)
                                                Character.Move.to(enabled, v638.Position + Vector3.new(0, Character.Config.HoverHeight, 0))

                                                continue
                                            else
                                                if Value > 14 then
                                                    Character.Colossal.rotationLock(false)
                                                    Character.Move.to(enabled, v635 + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0))
                                                else
                                                    Character.Move.cancel()
                                                    Character.Colossal.rotationLock(true)

                                                    if Position then
                                                        if Character.Colossal.SHOOT_COOLDOWN <= Objectives then
                                                            Position = not Character.Colossal._firing
                                                        else
                                                            Position = false
                                                        end
                                                    end

                                                    if Position then
                                                        Character.Colossal.fireCycle(inst, Character.Colossal.SHOOT_BASE, Character.Colossal.SHOOT_BARREL)
                                                        n11 = tick()
                                                    end
                                                end

                                                continue
                                            end
                                        end

                                        if Value > 14 then
                                            Character.Colossal.rotationLock(false)
                                            Character.Move.to(enabled, v635 + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0))
                                        else
                                            Character.Move.cancel()
                                            Character.Colossal.rotationLock(true)

                                            if Position then
                                                if Character.Colossal.SHOOT_COOLDOWN <= Objectives then
                                                    Position = not Character.Colossal._firing
                                                else
                                                    Position = false
                                                end
                                            end

                                            if Position then
                                                Character.Colossal.fireCycle(inst, Character.Colossal.SHOOT_BASE, Character.Colossal.SHOOT_BARREL)
                                                n11 = tick()
                                            end
                                        end

                                        continue
                                    else
                                        inst = nil

                                        continue
                                    end
                                else
                                    Character.Runtime.objectiveMode = false

                                    continue
                                end
                            end

                            v635 = inst:FindFirstChild("Base")

                            if v635 then
                                v635 = v635.Position
                                Objectives = tick() - n11
                                Value = (enabled.Position - v635).Magnitude

                                if Position then
                                    v637 = Character.Colossal.SHOOT_COOLDOWN <= Objectives
                                else
                                    v637 = Position
                                end

                                v638 = enabled:FindFirstChild("Cannon") ~= nil
                                v637 = not v637

                                if v637 then
                                    v637 = not (Character.Colossal._firing or v638)

                                    if v637 then
                                        v637 = Character.Colossal.SHOOT_COOLDOWN - Objectives > 1.5
                                    end
                                end

                                if v637 then
                                    v637 = Character.Colossal.erenPos()
                                    v638, v639 = Character.Target.smallTitanNape(v637 or v635)

                                    if v638 then
                                        if v637 then
                                            v637 = (v637 - v638.Position).Magnitude <= Character.Colossal.EREN_GUARD_RADIUS
                                        end
                                    else
                                        v637 = v638
                                    end

                                    if v637 then
                                        Character.Colossal.rotationLock(false)
                                        Character.Move.to(enabled, v638.Position + Vector3.new(0, Character.Config.HoverHeight, 0))

                                        continue
                                    else
                                        if Value > 14 then
                                            Character.Colossal.rotationLock(false)
                                            Character.Move.to(enabled, v635 + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0))
                                        else
                                            Character.Move.cancel()
                                            Character.Colossal.rotationLock(true)

                                            if Position then
                                                if Character.Colossal.SHOOT_COOLDOWN <= Objectives then
                                                    Position = not Character.Colossal._firing
                                                else
                                                    Position = false
                                                end
                                            end

                                            if Position then
                                                Character.Colossal.fireCycle(inst, Character.Colossal.SHOOT_BASE, Character.Colossal.SHOOT_BARREL)
                                                n11 = tick()
                                            end
                                        end

                                        continue
                                    end
                                end

                                if Value > 14 then
                                    Character.Colossal.rotationLock(false)
                                    Character.Move.to(enabled, v635 + Vector3.new(0, 6, 0))
                                else
                                    Character.Move.cancel()
                                    Character.Colossal.rotationLock(true)

                                    if Position then
                                        if Character.Colossal.SHOOT_COOLDOWN <= Objectives then
                                            Position = not Character.Colossal._firing
                                        else
                                            Position = false
                                        end
                                    end

                                    if Position then
                                        Character.Colossal.fireCycle(inst, Character.Colossal.SHOOT_BASE, Character.Colossal.SHOOT_BARREL)
                                        n11 = tick()
                                    end
                                end

                                continue
                            else
                                inst = nil

                                continue
                            end
                        end
                    else
                        enabled = Character.Runtime.objectiveMode

                        if enabled then
                            enabled = v631 ~= nil
                        end

                        if enabled then
                            inst = nil
                            Character.Colossal._firing = false
                            Character.Colossal.rotationLock(false)
                            Character.Move.cancel()
                            Character.Runtime.objectiveMode = false
                            v631 = nil
                        end

                        continue
                    end
                end
            end

            function onClose.value3(p129)
                if isfolder_() then
                    color33("In game finish the run first.")

                    return
                end

                Character.Lobby.thunderMode = true
                color33("Reading quest progress...")

                local questCache = Character.Thunder.openPanelAndRead(5)

                questCache = not next(questCache) and (Character.Lobby.questCache or {}) or questCache

                local n12

                if next(questCache) then
                    questCache = 0
                    n12 = 4
                else
                    t1.value7("Thunder: no GUI/cache progress running missions in order (full-auto)")
                    color33("No progress data running all missions in order...")
                    questCache = 0
                    n12 = 4
                end

                while true do
                    local enabled = p129.enabled

                    if enabled then
                        enabled = not isfolder_()
                    end

                    if not enabled then
                        color33(Character.Lobby.lastThunderStatus or "Idle.")

                        return
                    end

                    enabled = Character.Thunder.openPanelAndRead(4)
                    enabled = not next(enabled) and (Character.Lobby.questCache or {}) or enabled

                    local v643 = Character.Thunder.nextQuest(enabled)

                    if not v643 then
                        color34()
                        color33("All Thunder Spear quests complete!")
                        readfile_("Thunder Quest", "All quests done craft your Thunder Spear!", 5, "check")

                        break
                    end

                    enabled = Character.Thunder.missionProgressStr(v643, enabled)
                    color33(("Mission: %s %s/%s [%s]"):format(v643.name, v643.map, v643.objective, enabled))
                    t1.value7("Thunder: next mission", v643.name, "(" .. enabled .. ")")
                    color33("Creating session for " .. v643.name .. "...")

                    if Character.Thunder.runQuestSession(v643) then
                        Character.Lobby.thunderRan[v643.name] = true
                        enabled = tick() + 15
                        questCache = 0

                        while true do
                            local v644 = not isfolder_()

                            if v644 then
                                if tick() < enabled then
                                    v644 = p129.enabled
                                else
                                    v644 = false
                                end
                            end

                            if not v644 then
                                break
                            end

                            task.wait(1)
                        end

                        if isfolder_() then
                            Character.Thunder.beginFarming()
                            color33("In " .. v643.map .. " farming the objective...")

                            break
                        end
                    else
                        questCache = questCache + 1

                        if n12 <= questCache then
                            color34()
                            color33("Gave up on " .. v643.name .. " after " .. questCache .. " failed attempts.")
                            readfile_("Thunder Quest", "Couldn\'t create " .. v643.name .. " session stopped.", 5, "skull")

                            break
                        end

                        color33("Session create failed (" .. questCache .. "/" .. n12 .. ") retrying...")
                        task.wait(5)
                    end
                end

                color33(Character.Lobby.lastThunderStatus or "Idle.")
            end

            function onClose.value1()
                local v645 = Character.Gear.CATEGORIES[Character.Lobby.autoUpgrade.weapon]

                if not v645 then
                    return false
                end

                Character.Gear.switchWeapon(Character.Lobby.autoUpgrade.weapon)
                task.wait(0.5)

                local t22 = {}

                for _, v in ipairs(v645) do
                    t22[#t22 + 1] = v
                end

                v645 = Character.Stats.upgrades[Character.Lobby.autoUpgrade.weapon]

                if v645 then
                    table.sort(t22, function(p132, p133)
                        return (v645[p132] or 0) < (v645[p133] or 0)
                    end)
                end

                v645 = #t22

                local v649 = false

                while v645 > 0 do
                    local t23 = {}

                    for i = 1, v645 do
                        t23[#t23 + 1] = string.format("%q", t22[i])
                    end

                    local t24 = {
						["argsExpr"] = "{ " .. table.concat(t23, ", ") .. " }",
						["mapExpr"] = "out = (res ~= nil)",
						["timeout"] = 6
					}

                    t24 = Character.Actor.invoke("S_Equipment", "Upgrade", t24)

                    if not (t24 and t24.ok) then
                        break
                    end

                    if t24.data == true then
                        t1.value7("upgradeAll: success with " .. v645 .. "/" .. #t22 .. " stats")
                        v649 = true

                        break
                    end

                    v645 = v645 - 1

                    if v645 > 0 then
                        task.wait(0.3)
                    end
                end

                if v649 then
                    return v649
                end

                t1.value7("upgradeAll: not enough Gold for even the cheapest stat")

                return v649
            end

            color35.upgradeAll = onClose.value1

            end)

                local perkStorage = Character.Stats.perkStorage

                if not perkStorage or #perkStorage == 0 then

                end
            end

            function onClose.value1(p135)
                if not p135 or #p135 == 0 then
                    return true
                end

                local Remotes = t1.value1.RS:FindFirstChild("Assets") and t1.value1.RS.Assets:FindFirstChild("Remotes")

                if Remotes then
                    Remotes = t1.value1.RS.Assets.Remotes:FindFirstChild("GET")
                end

                if not Remotes then
                    t1.value7("deletePerks: GET remote not found")

                    return false
                end

                local result, result2

                Remotes, result, result2 = pcall(function()
                    return Remotes:InvokeServer("S_Equipment", "Delete", "Perk", p135)
                end)

                if not Remotes then
                    t1.value7("deletePerks: pcall failed:", result)
                end

                if not Remotes then
                    return Remotes
                end

                Remotes = result ~= nil

                return Remotes
            end

            function onClose.value1()
                local DeletePerksRarities = Character.Config.DeletePerksRarities

                if not DeletePerksRarities or #DeletePerksRarities == 0 then
                    DeletePerksRarities = Character.Util.flagSelection("SellPerksRarity")
                    Character.Config.DeletePerksRarities = DeletePerksRarities
                end

                if not DeletePerksRarities or #DeletePerksRarities == 0 then
                    t1.value7("AutoDeletePerks: no rarities selected")

                    return
                end

                local t26 = {}

                for _, DeletePerksRarity in ipairs(DeletePerksRarities) do
                    t26[DeletePerksRarity] = true
                end

                local v664 = Character.Inventory.fetchStoragePerks()

                t1.value7("AutoDeletePerks: cache has", #v664, "storage perks")

                if #v664 == 0 then
                    t1.value7("AutoDeletePerks: no storage perks found")

                    return
                end

                local v665, v666

                v664, v665, v666 = ipairs(v664)

                local t27 = {}

                while true do
                    v666, v811 = v664(v665, v666)

                    if not v666 then
                        break
                    end

                    if t26[v811.rarity] then
                        t27[#t27 + 1] = v811.id
                    end
                end

                if #t27 == 0 then
                    t1.value7("AutoDeletePerks: nothing to delete")

                    return
                end

                t1.value7("AutoDeletePerks: queued", #t27, "perks to delete")
                readfile_("Auto Delete Perks", string.format("Deleting %d perk(s)...", #t27), 3, "trash-2")
                task.wait(3)
                v666 = 20

                local n13 = 5
                local n14 = 0

                for i = 1, #t27, 20 do
                    local min = math.min
                    local v672 = #t27
                    local t28 = {}

                    for i2 = i, min(i + v666 - 1, v672) do
                        t28[#t28 + 1] = t27[i2]
                    end

                    local v675 = false

                    for i2 = 1, n13 do
                        if Character.Inventory.deletePerks(t28) then
                            v675 = true

                            break
                        end

                        t1.value7("AutoDeletePerks: batch attempt", i2, "failed, retrying in 2s")
                        task.wait(2)
                    end

                    if not v675 then
                        t1.value7("AutoDeletePerks: batch failed after", n13, "attempts, stopping")

                        return
                    end

                    n14 = n14 + #t28
                    t1.value7("AutoDeletePerks: deleted batch", #t28, "total so far", n14)
                end

                if not (n14 > 0) then
                    return n14
                end

                readfile_("Auto Delete Perks", string.format("Deleted %d perk(s) (%s)", n14, table.concat(DeletePerksRarities, ", ")), 4, "trash-2")

                return n14
            end

                        perkStorage[#perkStorage + 1] = v
                    end
                end

                Character.Stats.perkStorage = perkStorage
                Character.Lobby.busyLobby.AutoDeletePerks = nil
            end)

            function onClose.value1()
                local OpenCrateTypes = Character.Config.OpenCrateTypes

                if not OpenCrateTypes or #OpenCrateTypes == 0 then
                    OpenCrateTypes = Character.Util.flagSelection("OpenCrateTypes")
                    Character.Config.OpenCrateTypes = OpenCrateTypes
                end

                if not OpenCrateTypes or #OpenCrateTypes == 0 then
                    t1.value7("AutoOpenCrates: no crate types selected")

                    return 0
                end

                local n15 = 500
                local n16 = 0

                for _, OpenCrateType in ipairs(OpenCrateTypes) do
                    local v690 = Character.Inventory.CRATE_VARIANTS[OpenCrateType] or { OpenCrateType }

                    for _, v in ipairs(v690) do
                        local n17 = 0

                        while n17 < n15 do
                            local v694 = Character.Inventory.openCrate(v)

                            if v694 == nil then
                                break
                            end

                            n17 = n17 + 1
                            n16 = n16 + 1

                            if type(v694) == "table" then
                                Character.Stats.lastSlotData = v694
                            end

                            readfile_("Opening Crates", string.format("%s \226\128\148 opened #%d (total %d)", v, n17, n16), 1.5, "package-open")
                            task.wait(0.35)
                        end

                        if n17 > 0 then
                            t1.value7("AutoOpenCrates: opened", n17, v)
                        end
                    end
                end

                if n16 > 0 then
                    readfile_("Auto Open Crates", string.format("Opened %d crate(s) (%s). Rejoin to refresh your inventory.", n16, table.concat(OpenCrateTypes, ", ")), 7, "package-open")

                    return n16
                else
                    t1.value7("AutoOpenCrates: nothing to open")
                    readfile_("Auto Open Crates", "No matching crates to open.", 3, "package-open")

                    return n16
                end
            end

                if not isfolder_2 then
                    if isfolder_2 then
                        Character.ConfigManager.ensureFolder()
                        isfolder_2 = type(listfiles) == "function" and listfiles(Character.ConfigManager.FOLDER) or {}
                        v709 = t1.value3.Name .. "_"
                        t30 = {}
                        for _, v in ipairs(isfolder_2) do
                            match = v:match("([^/\\]+)%.json$")

                            if match then
                                v712 = match:sub(1, #v709) == v709
                            else
                                v712 = match
                            end

                            if v712 then
                                match = match:sub(#v709 + 1)
                                v, v712 = pcall(t1.value5.readfile, v)

                                if v then
                                    if v712 then
                                        if v712 == "{}" then
                                            v712 = false
                                        else
                                            v712 = #v712 > 2
                                        end
                                    end
                                else
                                    v712 = v
                                end

                                if v712 then
                                    t30[#t30 + 1] = match
                                end
                            end
                        end
                        table.sort(t30)

                        return t30
                    else
                        return {}
                    end

                    return
                end
                isfolder_2 = t1.value5.readfile
                if isfolder_2 then
                    Character.ConfigManager.ensureFolder()
                    isfolder_2 = type(listfiles) == "function" and listfiles(Character.ConfigManager.FOLDER) or {}

                local delfile_ = delfile

                delfile_ = type(delfile_) == "function" and delfile

                if delfile_ then
                    if delfile_ then
                        pcall(delfile_, v719)
                    else
                        pcall(t1.value5.writefile, v719, "{}")
                    end

                    t1.value7("ConfigManager.delete:", t1.value3.Name .. "_" .. p139)

                    return true
                end

                delfile_ = deletefile
                delfile_ = type(delfile_) == "function" and deletefile or nil

                if delfile_ then
                    pcall(delfile_, v719)
                else
                    pcall(t1.value5.writefile, v719, "{}")
                end

                t1.value7("ConfigManager.delete:", t1.value3.Name .. "_" .. p139)

                return true
            end

            function onClose.value2()

                elseif autoSkill.strategy == "Focus Support First" then
                    t31 = { autoSkill.support, autoSkill.offense, autoSkill.defense }
                else
                    t31 = { autoSkill.offense, autoSkill.defense, autoSkill.support }

							["perkSlot"] = true,

							["label"] = "Perk Slot " .. v728
						}
                    end
                end

                    t32[#t32 + 1] = v
                end

            end

        end

                        s12 = "fail err=" .. tostring(s12)

                else
                    s12 = S_Equipment
                end

                if not S_Equipment then

            function onClose.value4()
                if Character.StatsWebhook.url() == "" then
                    return
                end

                local lastEvent = Character.StatsWebhook.lastEvent
                local prestige = Character.Prestige.snapshot()
                local currentSlot = Character.Stats.currentSlot

                if currentSlot == lastEvent.slot then
                    if prestige then
                        currentSlot = lastEvent.prestige ~= nil and prestige.prestige

                        if currentSlot then
                            currentSlot = prestige.prestige > lastEvent.prestige
                        end

                        if currentSlot then
                            Character.StatsWebhook.send("Prestige Up!", string.format("%s reached **P%d** (was P%d).", Character.StatsWebhook.userTag(), prestige.prestige, lastEvent.prestige), 15844367, Character.StatsWebhook.progressFields(), {
								["mention"] = true
							})
                        else
                            currentSlot = lastEvent.level ~= nil and prestige.level

                            if currentSlot then
                                currentSlot = prestige.level > lastEvent.level
                            end

                            if currentSlot then
                                Character.StatsWebhook.send("Level Up!", string.format("%s is now **Level %d** (was %d).", Character.StatsWebhook.userTag(), prestige.level, lastEvent.level), 3447003, Character.StatsWebhook.progressFields())
                            end
                        end

                        lastEvent.level = prestige.level
                        lastEvent.prestige = prestige.prestige
                    end

                    if lastEvent.shadowBan == true then
                        prestige = false
                    else
                        prestige = Character.Stats.shadowBan == true
                    end

                    if not prestige then
                        lastEvent.shadowBan = Character.Stats.shadowBan

                        return
                    end

                    Character.StatsWebhook.send("\226\154\160\239\184\143 Shadow Ban Detected!", string.format("%s is shadow-banned%s.", Character.StatsWebhook.userTag(), Character.Stats.disabledReason and " \226\128\148 " .. Character.Stats.disabledReason or ""), 15158332, Character.StatsWebhook.progressFields(), {
						["mention"] = true
					})
                    lastEvent.shadowBan = Character.Stats.shadowBan

                    return
                else
                    lastEvent.slot = currentSlot

                    if prestige then
                        currentSlot = prestige.level
                    else
                        currentSlot = prestige
                    end

                    lastEvent.level = currentSlot

                    if not prestige then
                        lastEvent.prestige = prestige
                        lastEvent.shadowBan = Character.Stats.shadowBan

                        return
                    end

                    prestige = prestige.prestige
                    lastEvent.prestige = prestige
                    lastEvent.shadowBan = Character.Stats.shadowBan

                    return
                end
            end

            onClose.value2.checkEvents = onClose.value4
            queue_on_teleport_ = function(p157)
                local t45 = {}

                if type(p157) == "table" then
                    for k, v in pairs(p157) do
                        local v819 = type(k) == "number" and v and v or k

                        if type(v819) == "string" then
                            t45[#t45 + 1] = v819
                        end
                    end

                    return t45
                end

                if type(p157) ~= "string" then
                    return t45
                end

                t45[1] = p157

                return t45
            end

            function onClose.value3.updateTargets()
                local targets = {}

                local function v821(p158, p159)
                    local v822, v823, v824 = ipairs(p158)
                    local v825 = false

                    while true do
                        local v826

                        v824, v826 = v822(v823, v824)

                        if not v824 then
                            break
                        end

                        v825 = v826 == "Any" and true or v825
                    end

                    if not v825 then
                        for _, v in ipairs(p158) do
                            if v == "Any" then
                                v825 = false
                            else
                                v825 = not table.find(targets, v)
                            end

                            if v825 then
                                targets[#targets + 1] = v
                            end
                        end

                        return
                    end

                    p158 = p159 or p158

                    for _, v in ipairs(p158) do
                        if v == "Any" then
                            v825 = false
                        else
                            v825 = not table.find(targets, v)
                        end

                        if v825 then
                            targets[#targets + 1] = v
                        end
                    end
                end

                v821(Character.Lobby.family.epics, Character.Family.EPIC)
                v821(Character.Lobby.family.legends, Character.Family.LEGEND)
                v821(Character.Lobby.family.mythics, Character.Family.MYTHIC)
                Character.Lobby.family.targets = targets
            end

                local match = Character.Util.safeIndex(t1.value4, "Interface", "Customisation", "Family", "Family", "Title")

                if not match then
                    return match
                end

                match = match.Text:match("^(%S+)")

                return match
            end

            function onClose.value8()
                if not color34() then
                    return
                end

                local sched = Character.Lobby.sched
                local autoPrestige

                if sched.prestige then
                    autoPrestige = Character.Tasks.autoPrestige

                    if not Character.Lobby.restoring and (color34() and not autoPrestige:isRunning()) then
                        t1.value7("IndependentLayer: start " .. autoPrestige.name)
                        autoPrestige:start()
                    end
                end

                if sched.skill then
                    autoPrestige = Character.Tasks.autoSkill

                    if not Character.Lobby.restoring and (color34() and not autoPrestige:isRunning()) then
                        t1.value7("IndependentLayer: start " .. autoPrestige.name)
                        autoPrestige:start()
                    end
                end

                if sched.gear then
                    autoPrestige = Character.Tasks.autoUpgrade

                    if not Character.Lobby.restoring and (color34() and not autoPrestige:isRunning()) then
                        t1.value7("IndependentLayer: start " .. autoPrestige.name)
                        autoPrestige:start()
                    end
                end

                if sched.mission then
                    autoPrestige = Character.Tasks.autoCreate

                    if not Character.Lobby.restoring and (color34() and not autoPrestige:isRunning()) then
                        t1.value7("IndependentLayer: start " .. autoPrestige.name)
                        autoPrestige:start()
                    end
                end

                if sched.raid then
                    autoPrestige = Character.Tasks.autoRaid

                    if not Character.Lobby.restoring and (color34() and not autoPrestige:isRunning()) then
                        t1.value7("IndependentLayer: start " .. autoPrestige.name)
                        autoPrestige:start()
                    end
                end

                if sched.wave then
                    autoPrestige = Character.Tasks.autoWave

                    if not Character.Lobby.restoring and (color34() and not autoPrestige:isRunning()) then
                        t1.value7("IndependentLayer: start " .. autoPrestige.name)
                        autoPrestige:start()
                    end
                end

                if sched.deletePerks then
                    autoPrestige = Character.Tasks.autoDeletePerks

                    if not Character.Lobby.restoring and (color34() and not autoPrestige:isRunning()) then
                        t1.value7("IndependentLayer: start " .. autoPrestige.name)
                        autoPrestige:start()
                    end
                end

                if sched.openCrates then
                    autoPrestige = Character.Tasks.autoOpenCrates

                    if not Character.Lobby.restoring and (color34() and not autoPrestige:isRunning()) then
                        t1.value7("IndependentLayer: start " .. autoPrestige.name)
                        autoPrestige:start()
                    end
                end

                if not sched.claimAchievements then
                    return
                end

                sched = Character.Tasks.autoClaimAchievements

                if Character.Lobby.restoring then
                    return
                end

                if not color34() then
                    return
                end

                if sched:isRunning() then
                    return
                end

                t1.value7("IndependentLayer: start " .. sched.name)
                sched:start()
            end

            function onClose.value13()
                local v856 = tick() + 12
                local v857 = v856 < tick()

                while true do
                    v857 = Character.Util.safeIndex(t1.value4, "Interface", "Chests")

                            if v856 then
                                color32(v856)
                                t1.value7("openChests: Finish clicked")
                            else
                                t1.value7("openChests: Finish MISSING after retry \226\128\148 stuck")
                            end

                            return true
                        end

                        t1.value7("openChests: Finish not found in 12s \226\128\148 retrying once")
                        task.wait(2)
                        v856 = color37(v857, "Finish", true, 8)

                        if v856 then
                            color32(v856)
                            t1.value7("openChests: Finish clicked")
                        else
                            t1.value7("openChests: Finish MISSING after retry \226\128\148 stuck")
                        end

                        return true
                    end

                    task.wait(0.3)

                    if v856 < tick() then
                        v857 = nil

                        break
                    end
                end

                if not v857 then
                    return false
                end

                v856 = color37(v857, "Free", false, 8)

                if v856 then
                    color32(v856)
                    t1.value7("openChests: Free clicked")
                end

                if Character.Config.OpenBothChests then
                    task.wait(1.5)
                    v856 = color37(v857, "Premium", false, 10)

                    if v856 then
                        color32(v856)
                        t1.value7("openChests: Premium clicked")
                    end
                end

                v856 = color37(v857, "Finish", true, 12)

                if v856 then
                    if v856 then
                        color32(v856)
                        t1.value7("openChests: Finish clicked")
                    else
                        t1.value7("openChests: Finish MISSING after retry \226\128\148 stuck")
                    end

                    return true
                end

                t1.value7("openChests: Finish not found in 12s \226\128\148 retrying once")
                task.wait(2)
                v856 = color37(v857, "Finish", true, 8)

                if v856 then
                    color32(v856)
                    t1.value7("openChests: Finish clicked")
                else
                    t1.value7("openChests: Finish MISSING after retry \226\128\148 stuck")
                end

                return true
            end

            function onClose.value13(p171, p172)
                task.delay(p172 + 0.5, function()
                    if not Character.Runtime.farming then
                        return
                    end

                    local v859 = Character.Util.safeIndex(t1.value4, "Interface", "Rewards")
                    local Visible

                    if v859 then
                        Visible = v859.Visible
                    else
                        Visible = v859
                    end

                    if not (Visible and v859 and v859) then
                        v859 = Character.Util.safeIndex(workspace, "Unclimbable", "Cutscene")

                        if v859 then
                            v859 = #v859:GetChildren() > 0
                        end

                        if v859 then
                            pcall(Character.Features.skipActive)
                        end
                    end

                    v859 = tick() + 20

                    local Visible2

                    while true do
                        if true then
                            Visible = Character.Util.safeIndex(t1.value4, "Interface", "Rewards")

                            if Visible then
                                Visible2 = Visible.Visible
                            else
                                Visible2 = Visible
                            end
                        end

                        Visible = not (Visible2 and Visible and Visible) and true or false

                        if Visible then
                            Visible = tick() < v859
                        end

                        if not Visible then
                            break
                        end

                        task.wait(0.15)
                    end

                    if not Character.Runtime.farming then
                        return
                    end

                    v859 = Character.Util.safeIndex(t1.value4, "Interface", "Rewards")

                    if v859 then
                        Visible = v859.Visible
                    else
                        Visible = v859
                    end

                    if not (Visible and v859 and v859) then
                        v859 = Character.Util.safeIndex(t1.value4, "Interface", "Chests")

                        if v859 then
                            Visible = v859.Visible
                        else
                            Visible = v859
                        end

                        v859 = Visible and color37(v859, "Finish", false, 5)

                        if v859 then
                            t1.value7("waitForRewardsThen: fallback Finish click")
                            color32(v859)
                            task.wait(1.5)
                        end
                    end

                    v859 = tick() + 10

                    while true do
                        if true then
                            Visible = Character.Util.safeIndex(t1.value4, "Interface", "Rewards")

                            if Visible then
                                Visible2 = Visible.Visible
                            else
                                Visible2 = Visible
                            end
                        end

                        Visible = not (Visible2 and Visible and Visible) and true or false

                        if Visible then
                            Visible = tick() < v859
                        end

                        if not Visible then
                            if not Character.Runtime.farming then
                                return
                            end

                            v859 = Character.Util.safeIndex(t1.value4, "Interface", "Rewards")

                            if v859 then
                                Visible = v859.Visible
                            else
                                Visible = v859
                            end

                            if not (Visible and v859 and v859 or nil) then
                                return
                            end

                            p171()

                            return
                        end

                        task.wait(0.15)
                    end
                end)
            end

            function Character.UI.refreshFarmStatus()
                local farm = Character.UI.paragraphs.farm

                if farm then
                    if Character.Runtime.farming then
                        local v875 = tick() - Character.Stats.FarmStartTime

                        v875 = math.floor(v875)

                        local setParagraph = Character.UI.setParagraph
                        local format = string.format
                        local v878 = v875 / 60

                        setParagraph(farm, format("Time: %dm %ds | Missions: %d | Raids: %d | Gold: %d | EXP: %d", math.floor(v878), v875 % 60, Character.Stats.MissionsCompleted, Character.Stats.RaidsCompleted, Character.Stats.GoldCollected, Character.Stats.ExpCollected), "Farm Status  \226\151\143  RUNNING")

                        return
                    else
                        Character.UI.setParagraph(farm, "Not farming", "Farm Status  \226\151\139  IDLE")

                        return
                    end

                    return
                else
                    return
                end
            end

                        if v965 then
                            v965 = v965.claimed and "\226\156\147 claimed" or (v965.locked and "locked" or v965.current .. "/" .. v965.target)

                        t48[#t48 + 1] = "    " .. tag .. ": " .. (v965 or "?")
                    end
                end

                if not p241 then
                    Character.UI.setParagraph(color35, table.concat(t48, "\n"))

                    return
                end

                t48[#t48 + 1] = "(cached open the quest panel for live data)"
                Character.UI.setParagraph(color35, table.concat(t48, "\n"))
            end

            end)
        else
            pcall(function()
                game:GetService("StarterGui"):SetCore("SendNotification", {
					["Title"] = "MahmutHub Error",
					["Text"] = "Failed to load UI (network?). Try executing again.",
					["Duration"] = 10
				})
            end)
        end
    end
end
